exs: She has wrinkles around her eyes. 她眼角有皱纹。
His shirt was full of wrinkles. 他的衬衫满是褶皱。
words.root: 不可拆：中古英语 wrincle，源自古诺尔斯语 wrinkill 或古英语 wrencan（扭动、弯曲）；词根义“扭曲”→引申为“皮肤或织物表面的褶皱线”
words.note: iron out wrinkles 熨平褶皱；近义辨析：这组词都有“使皱”的意思，其区别是： - wrinkle: 指使某物起折痕或把某物弄皱。 - fold: 指对折或叠若干次。

defs.cn: 手腕；腕关节；用腕力移动

exs: He broke his wrist climbing rocks for a cigarette ad. 他为了一个香烟广告攀岩折断了手腕。
words.root: 不可拆：古英语 wriċst，源自原始日耳曼语 *wrīkiz，与 turn（转动）相关，指可旋转的关节部位
words.note: vs. ankle: wrist 位于手臂末端连接手部，负责精细操作和腕力动作；ankle 位于腿末端连接脚部，主要承担支撑和行走功能。区分点在于解剖位置及功能侧重（上肢灵活性 vs. 下肢承重性）。

defs.cn: 写；写字；写作；作曲；写信

exs: She decided to write a letter to her old friend who moved abroad last year. 她决定给去年搬去国外的老朋友写封信。
It takes patience and practice to learn how to write clearly and concisely in academic contexts. 学会在学术语境中清晰简洁地写作需要耐心和练习。
words.root: 不可拆：源自古英语 writan（意为刻、划、写作），属日耳曼语族，无拉丁/希腊词根可拆。
words.note: 与compose辨析：write侧重通过笔或键盘将文字记录下来的动作及过程，适用于书信、日记、文章等广泛文本；compose强调构思、组织与创作的艺术性思维过程，多用于音乐、诗歌、正式演讲或需要精心结构的复杂文本。

defs.cn: 作家；作者

exs: She’s one of my favourite writers. 她是我最喜欢的作家之一。
a science-fiction writer 科幻小说作家
words.root: writ-er
words.note: 【近义辨析】含义广泛，一般指以写作为职业的人。（近义词：author）

defs.cn: 书写；作品；著作；[法] 笔迹；书写（write的ing形式）

exs: Some of his most powerful writing is based on his childhood experiences. 他的一些最震慑人心的作品是根据儿时经历写成的。
words.root: 不可拆：源自古英语 wrītan（意为“划出、刻写”），属日耳曼语系，与古诺斯语 rita 同源；现代形式由动词 write + -ing 后缀构成，表示动作过程或结果。
words.note: 与 works 辨析：writing 侧重指“文字记录这一行为或具体的笔迹/文稿本身”，强调物理载体或书写动作；works 则多指作者完成的“作品整体”，强调艺术性或思想性的产出集合。与 literature 辨析：writing 泛指任何书面表达，包括信件、笔记等实用文本，语域较宽且中性；literature 特指具有审美价值或学术地位的“文学作品”或“文献资料”，语域更正式且具有文化积淀感。

defs.cn: 错误地；邪恶的；不正当地；坏事；不公正；错误的

exs: He felt he had done his friend a great wrong by betraying his confidence. 他背叛了朋友的信任，觉得自己对朋友做了极大的不义之事。
You were wrong to ignore the safety warnings during the experiment. 你在实验期间忽视安全警告是错误的。
words.root: 不可拆：源自古英语 wrang，意为扭曲的、不正的，属日耳曼语族固有词汇，非拉丁/希腊词根合成
words.note: 侧重道德、法律或事实上的错误，常指违背规则或真理。辨析：与 incorrect 相比，incorrect 更中性，仅指不符合标准答案或数据；与 mistaken 相比，mistaken 多指认知或判断偏差，而非行为过失。典型搭配：do wrong（做坏事）、in the wrong（理亏）、wrongdoing（违法行为）。语域：通用，但在指责语境中语气较强。

defs.cn: 施乐（商标名，美国办公设备制造公司）；影印；静电印刷品；用静电复印法复印

exs: Could you xerox this letter, please? 请复印一下这封信好吗？
words.root: xerox
words.note: 【近义辨析】指用静电复印或用静电印刷术复制。（近义词：duplicate、copy）

defs.cn: 乘游艇；驾游艇；游艇；快艇；轻舟

exs: His 36 ft yacht sank suddenly last summer. 他的36英尺游艇去年夏天突然沉没了。
words.root: 不可拆：源自荷兰语 jacht，意为‘狩猎’或‘快速的船’（jagen 为追赶、驱赶），17世纪传入英语指代快速帆船，后泛指游艇。
words.note: 与 vessel 辨析：vessel 是广义的‘船舶/容器’，涵盖货轮、军舰等所有水上交通工具，语域正式且中性；yacht 特指用于休闲、竞技或私人享乐的‘游艇’，强调非商业运输用途及豪华属性。典型搭配：private yacht（私人游艇）vs cargo vessel（货船）。

defs.cn: 美国佬；美国人；洋基队（美国棒球队名）

exs: The tourists from Europe jokingly referred to the locals as Yankees. 来自欧洲的游客开玩笑地称当地人为“美国佬”。
New York's baseball team, known simply as the Yankees, has a massive fan base. 纽约的棒球队被称为“洋基队”，拥有庞大的粉丝群体。
words.root: yank-ee
words.note: 辨析：'Yankee'常带有口语色彩或特定文化语境（如美国内战历史、棒球文化），在非美国人眼中略带调侃甚至轻微冒犯意味；'American'是中性、标准的国籍称谓，适用于正式场合。使用场景上，谈论棒球队用'Yankees'（复数大写），指代北方人时用'Yankee'。

defs.cn: 院子；码（英制中丈量长度单位，1码=3英尺）；庭院；帆桁；把…关进或围在畜栏里

exs: a builder’s yard 建筑工地
a timber yard 木场
words.root: 不可拆：古英语 'gyrd' (rod, stick) 或 'gerd'，与日耳曼语系中关于‘围合’、‘界限’或‘杆状物’的概念同源；后演变为表示封闭区域（院子）及长度单位（原指测量用的杆/杖）
words.note: 与 courtyard 辨析：yard 侧重指房屋周围的露天土地，功能性强，可涵盖前院、后院或工作区，也可指动物围栏；courtyard 特指被建筑物完全或部分包围的内部庭院，更强调建筑结构的依附性和景观/休闲属性，常见于大型庄园、酒店或公共建筑。

defs.cn: 纱线；奇谈；故事；用纱线缠；讲故事

exs: He spent the evening spinning a yarn about his adventures in the Amazon. 他花了一晚上编造他在亚马逊冒险的奇谈。
The grandmother knitted a warm scarf using thick wool yarn. 奶奶用粗羊毛纱线织了一条暖和的围巾。
words.root: 不可拆：源自古英语 gearn，日耳曼语族基础词汇；古义为纺线/绳，后引申为‘讲述’（因编织故事如纺织纤维）
words.note: 与 story 辨析：story 是通用词，指任何叙述；yarn 特指夸张、离奇或冗长的口头故事（a tall tale），常含‘吹牛’或‘闲谈’意味。与 thread 辨析：thread 指单股细线或逻辑线索；yarn 强调由多股纤维拧成的粗纱线或由此构成的叙事体

defs.cn: 哈欠；裂口；打呵欠；裂开；张开；打著呵欠说

exs: She yawned all through the lecture. 整场讲座她都在打哈欠。
He gave a big yawn and stretched his arms. 他打了个大哈欠，伸了伸胳膊。
words.root: 不可拆：源自古英语 geonian（意为“打哈欠”），与日耳曼语族相关，非拉丁/希腊派生词；古义引申为“张开”，因张口动作而得名。
words.note: 熟词生义：裂口；张开

defs.cn: 年；年度；历年；年纪；一年的期间；某年级的学生

exs: The company reported a significant increase in revenue over the past fiscal year. 该公司报告过去一个财政年度的收入显著增长。
He spent his formative years studying abroad, which greatly broadened his horizons. 他在形成性格的几年里在国外学习，这极大地开阔了他的视野。
words.root: 不可拆：源自古英语 geāru，与拉丁语 hībernus（冬季的）及希腊语 ὥρα（季节/时刻）有远亲关系，属日耳曼语族基础时间单位词
words.note: 辨析：year侧重指地球绕太阳公转一周的时间周期或自然年度，常用于具体时间点（in 2023）及教育年限；anniversary专指某事发生后的周年纪念日；term多用于学术或合同规定的学期、任期；fiscal year特指财政年度。搭配：academic year学年，leap year闰年，by the year到...为止。

defs.cn: 每年的；每年；一年一次；年刊；年鉴

exs: Clients normally pay fees in advance, monthly, quarterly, or yearly. 客户们通常提前付费，或按月，或按季度，或按年。
words.root: 无-(无)+year(年,古英语ġēar)+-ly(形容词/副词后缀)；年→每年的/每年
words.note: 侧重强调频率或时间间隔，常作形容词修饰报告、订阅等（如 yearly report），也可作副词表示“每年”；与 annually 相比，annually 更正式且常用于官方统计语境，而 yearly 口语色彩稍强，亦可指“持续一年的”。

defs.cn: 渴望；向往；思念；想念；怀念；同情

exs: He yearned for a quiet life in the country. 他渴望乡村的宁静生活。
She yearned to see her family again. 她渴望再见到家人。
words.root: 不可拆：源自古英语 gyran（哀哭、悲叹），经中古英语 yernen 吸收日耳曼‘渴望’义，无拉丁/希腊词缀；哀哭/悲叹→思念、渴望、向往
words.note: yearn for 渴望；yearn to do 渴望做；近义辨析：这组词都有“渴望”的意思，其区别是： - long: 指诚心诚意地渴望某事或物。 - yearn: 通常指急迫不安地渴望或向往，着重怀有柔情或热情。 - thirst: 原义指对食物或饮料的渴求，引申指全力以求。

defs.cn: 酵母；泡沫；酵母片；引起骚动因素

exs: dried/fresh yeast 干／新鲜酵母
yeast extract 酵母精
words.root: 不可拆：基础日耳曼词，源自古英语 gist/gyst（发酵泡沫），无前后缀
words.note: 与 bubble、foam 辨析：yeast 指发酵用的酵母或酿造/面包制作中因发酵形成的泡沫层；bubble 指单个球形气泡；foam 指大量气泡聚集成的泡沫。若语境涉及烘焙、发酵、酿酒，优先用 yeast；若是一粒独立气室用 bubble；若是肥皂泡、海浪沫等成片泡沫用 foam。

defs.cn: 大叫；叫喊；喊声；叫声；喊叫着说

exs: ‘Help me!’ she yelled hysterically. “救救我！”她歇斯底里地大叫。
I yelled out, ‘Here I am!’ 我大声喊道:“我在这儿！”
words.root: 不可拆：古英语 giellan（大声呼喊）
words.note: 【近义辨析】多指求援、鼓励时的呼叫。也可指因外界因素刺激而发出尖厉声音。（近义词：call、scream、roar、shriek）

defs.cn: 黄色的；黄皮肤的；黄色；黄种人；黄色颜料；使变黄或发黄

exs: The leaves turn yellow in autumn due to the breakdown of chlorophyll. 秋天树叶变黄是因为叶绿素的分解。
He was accused of being yellow, refusing to fight despite the insults. 他被指责胆小怯懦，尽管受到侮辱仍拒绝还击。
words.root: 不可拆：源自古英语 geolu，与日耳曼语族词根相关，原始印欧语词根 *ghel- 意为“闪烁、发光”，指代阳光或火焰的颜色。
words.note: 与 gold（金色）辨析：gold 侧重金属光泽、财富象征及更饱和的橙黄色调；yellow 为光谱基本色，涵盖柠檬黄至土黄，常关联自然物（如香蕉、花）或警示标志，不具贵金属价值暗示。

defs.cn: 是, 是的；是（表示肯定）

exs: When asked if he was ready to begin, he simply nodded and said yes. 当被问及是否准备好开始时，他只是点点头说了声“是的”。
She hesitated for a moment before finally answering yes to the proposal. 她犹豫了片刻，最终对这项提议给出了肯定的答复。
words.root: 不可拆：古英语 gīse（意为“如此、这样”），由指示代词 þis 演变而来，非拉丁或希腊构词法；原指对事实的确认，后固定为肯定回答。
words.note: 与 affirmatively 辨析：yes 是日常对话中最通用的肯定回应，侧重态度或简单的事实确认，语域中性偏口语；affirmatively 则具有强烈的正式和法律色彩，通常用于法庭质询、官方文件或逻辑测试中，强调“经过核实后的确切肯定”，二者在正式公文或司法语境下不可互换。

defs.cn: 昨天；往昔

exs: What seemed like a crisis yesterday is already forgotten by his followers. 昨天看似危机的事情已经被他的追随者遗忘。
We must learn from yesterday to avoid making the same mistakes today. 我们必须从昨日汲取教训，以免今日重蹈覆辙。
words.root: 不可拆：源自古英语 gesteran dæg，由 geasteran（昨天）和 dæg（日）组成；其中 geasteran 源自原始日耳曼语 *gastrą，与今昔对比中的“过去”概念相关
words.note: 与 'the past' 辨析：yesterday 特指紧邻今天的前一天或象征性的近期过去，具有明确的时间边界感，常用于口语及具体叙事；the past 则泛指所有已发生的历史时间段，涵盖范围更广且更具抽象性。例如用 yesterday's news 强调消息的过时性，而用 the past to reflect on history 进行宏观回顾。

defs.cn: 还；但是；已经；然而

exs: She hasn't finished her homework yet, but she will soon. 她还没有完成作业，但很快就会了。
The plan seemed impossible at first; yet, we managed to execute it successfully. 起初这个计划似乎不可能实现；然而，我们最终成功执行了它。
words.root: 不可拆：源自古英语 giet/geot，与日耳曼语族其他语言同源；古英语义为“仍然/还”，引申出转折和完成时态副词用法。
words.note: 【近义辨析】常用于否定句，语气比still稍强。指不管作出多大努力或让步，仍达不到预期的结果。（近义词：whereas、nevertheless、but、however）

defs.cn: 屈服；让路；产生；出产；让步；产量

exs: The fields yield a good crop every year. 这些田地每年都有好收成。
The government refused to yield to the protesters' demands. 政府拒绝向抗议者的要求让步。
words.root: 不可拆：古英语 gieldan（意为支付、偿还、臣服），日耳曼语源
words.note: 熟词生义：让路；屈服；近义辨析：这组词都有“收成”的意思，其区别是： - yield: 指生产物，农作物的总产量。 - harvest: 主要指农作物或水果的收获量，有时也指收割的行为。 - crop: 普通用词，侧重指农作物一次收割或一季的收成。

defs.cn: 轭；束缚；牛轭；结合；给…上轭

exs: the yoke of tradition 传统的枷锁
words.root: 不可拆：源自古英语 geoc，与拉丁语 iugum（轭）同源，最终源自印欧语根 *yeug-（连接/结合）；词根义‘连接’→引申为‘束缚/配对’
words.note: 辨析1：vs. chain。Chain侧重物理上的‘链条、镣铐’或抽象的‘连续系列’，强调刚性限制和线性连接；Yoke特指用于牲口拉车的‘轭’或比喻‘奴役、沉重负担’（如 under the yoke of tyranny），强调两个主体被强制绑定在一起共同承受压力，具有更强的‘从属/压迫’语义色彩。辨析2：vs. couple。Couple是中性的‘一对/夫妇’，强调自然配对或社会关系；Yoke作为动词时意为‘将…套上轭’或‘使…紧密相连’，通常暗示一种人为的、有时是不情愿的‘强行结合’或‘捆绑’（e.g., yoked together by fate），语体更正式且带有文学性或负面约束感。

defs.cn: 蛋黄；卵黄；蛋黄液；蛋中黄色部分

exs: She separated the yolk from the white. 她把蛋黄和蛋清分开。
The yolk is rich in fat. 蛋黄富含脂肪。
words.root: 不可拆：源自荷兰语 yolke，经中古英语演变；词根义→蛋黄
words.note: the yolk of an egg 蛋黄

defs.cn: 你；你们

exs: You are expected to submit the final report before Friday. 你必须在周五前提交最终报告。
In this culture, you often greet strangers with a warm smile. 在这种文化中，人们通常以温暖的微笑问候陌生人。
words.root: 不可拆：源自古英语 ēow（复数宾格）和 ēower（复数属格），经中古英语演变，受古诺斯语影响合并单复数形式；词根义→第二人称代词
words.note: 与 'one' 辨析：'you' 指具体的对话对象或泛指大众时语气更直接、口语化；'one' 用于极正式文体或学术写作中指代泛指的‘任何人’，避免使用 'you' 带来的随意感。例如在学术论文中用 'One cannot ignore...' 而非 'You cannot ignore...'。

defs.cn: 年轻的；初期的；没有经验的；年轻人；（动物的）崽；仔

exs: The young man helped the old lady cross. 那个年轻人扶老太太过马路。
She is too young to travel alone. 她太小了，不能独自旅行。
words.root: 不可拆：古英语 geong（意为新鲜的、年轻的，与德语 jung 同源）
words.note: 近义辨析：这组词都有“年轻的，年幼的”的意思，其区别是： - adolescent: 指13至16岁左右处于青春期的人，尚不成熟。 - youthful: 褒义或贬义均可用。指具有青年人的外貌或年轻人应具有的品格。 - juvenile: 较正式用词，一般12岁以下的少年，着重其生理和智力上的不成熟。 - young: 强调年龄小，处于生长的前期。

defs.cn: 年轻人；少年

exs: Other youngsters are not so lucky. 其他的年轻人没有这么幸运。
words.root: young-(年轻的,古英语 geong/原始日耳曼 *jungaz)+-ster(名词后缀,古英语 -estre)；young(年轻)→年轻人
words.note: 【近义辨析】泛指任何年龄的儿童或者少年，多指男孩，多为年长者的使用。（近义词：child、infant、baby）

defs.cn: 你的；你们的

exs: Your participation in the volunteer program demonstrates a strong sense of social responsibility. 你参加志愿者项目展现了强烈的社会责任感。
Please review your notes before the final exam to ensure you understand the key concepts. 请在期末考试前复习你的笔记，以确保你理解关键概念。
words.root: 不可拆：源自中古英语 youre，由古英语 eower（复数属格）演变而来；原始日耳曼语 *wer- 词根表示“你/你们”的属格形式，经语音弱化形成现代拼写 your。
words.note: 与 your own 辨析：your 是通用形容词性物主代词，仅表示归属关系，可被修饰或泛指；your own 强调排他性或亲身拥有权（如 “make it your own”），带有主观掌控色彩。在四六级语境中，your 常作定语直接修饰名词（your opinion），而 your own 多用于强调个人独特体验或责任时，语气更强且具修辞效果。

defs.cn: 你（们）的东西；你的责任[义务]；你的家属；来信；尊函；你（们）的（东西）

exs: This decision is yours to make, not mine. 这个决定由你来做，而不是我来做。
Please find enclosed the documents that are yours. 请查收随函附上的、属于你的文件。
words.root: 不可拆：源自古英语 'iwre' (of you)，属日耳曼语系代词演变，无法按拉丁/希腊构词法拆解
words.note: 与 'your' 辨析：'your' 是形容词性物主代词，必须后接名词（如 your book）；'yours' 是名词性物主代词，单独使用代替 'your + noun'（如 The book is yours），强调归属而非修饰。在书信结尾 'Yours sincerely' 中为固定套语，无实义指代。

defs.cn: 你自己

exs: Please make yourself at home while I finish these documents. 在我处理这些文件时，请别客气，就像在自己家一样。
The responsibility for the outcome lies with yourself, not with your team members. 结果的责任在于你自己，而不在你的团队成员。

defs.cn: 青年；青春；年轻人；青年时期；青年们

defs.cn: 热情；热忱；热心；积极；狂热

defs.cn: 热心的；狂热的；积极的；一心一意的；满腔热情的

defs.cn: 曲折的；锯齿形的；之字形的；使成之字形；使曲折行进；曲折行进

words.note: 与meander辨析：zigzag强调急剧、频繁的方向改变，路径呈明显的锯齿或之字形，通常指有意识规划或受地形限制导致的曲折；meander侧重缓慢、随意且不规则的蜿蜒流动，如河流弯曲或思绪漫无目的游走，缺乏zigzag那种尖锐转折的力度感。

words.note: a no-parking zone 禁停区；time zone 时区；近义辨析：这组词都有“地区”的意思，其区别是： - region: 普通用词，常指地球上、大气中具有自然分界线的区域，特指按照气候、人体或其他特征鲜明、自成一体的地区。 - area: 普通用词，指整体中较大的，界线不分明的一部分。 - district: 多指由政府等机构出于行政管理等目的而明确划分的地区。 - belt: 从本义“带，带状物”引申而指任何广阔的长条地带，也可指种植某种作物的地区。 - neighbourhood: 指比section的划定更清楚，范围更小。具体指城市中的住宅区，也可指附近一带。 - zone: 科技用词，指圆形或弧形地带，尤指地图上按温度划分的五个地带。用作一般意义时，也可指具有某种特征的其它地区。 - section: 普通用词，指城市、国家或天然界线形成的地区。 - quarter: 指城市里具有相同性质或独特风味的地区，比section范围小，但划分更精确。

The adjustable chair, designed for long study sessions, supports the back. 这把为长时间学习设计的可调节椅子支撑背部。

defs.cn: 赞赏, 钦佩, 引人赞赏的对象

words.root: ad-（向）+ mir（惊奇）→ 赞叹
exs: Her calm voice won admiration from everyone in the meeting room. 她平静的声音赢得了会议室里所有人的赞赏。
The teacher spoke with admiration, noting how the students improved. 老师带着赞赏说，指出学生们如何进步。

defs.cn: 青春期的, 青少年的
青少年

words.root: ad-（向）+ al（养）→ 长大 → 青少年
exs: The adolescent athlete struggled to balance school and training. 这位青少年运动员努力平衡学业和训练。
Many adolescent students feel anxious when exams approach every term. 许多青少年学生每学期考试临近时都感到焦虑。

defs.cn: 采用, 采纳, 收养；[法] 收养, 采纳, 采用

words.root: ad-（向）+ opt（选）→ 采纳
exs: The company's adoption of flexible hours improved employee morale. 公司采用弹性工作时间提高了员工士气。
The adoption of the new policy, announced yesterday, caused debate. 昨天宣布的新政策被采用，引发了争论。

defs.cn: 崇拜, 爱慕, 喜爱
崇拜, 爱慕

words.root: ad-（向）+ or（祈祷）→ 崇拜
exs: Many teenagers adore the singer's raw emotional performances. 许多青少年崇拜这位歌手真挚而富有情感的表演。
She adores her grandmother's stories, listening attentively every evening. 她酷爱听祖母的故事，每晚都专心聆听。

defs.cn: 有利的, 有益的

words.root: advantage（优势）+ -ous（具有）→ 有利的
exs: A bilingual resume is advantageous in this competitive market. 双语简历在这个竞争激烈的市场中很有优势。
Candidates with internship experience are advantageous because they adapt faster. 有实习经验的求职者更具优势，因为他们适应得更快。

defs.cn: 不利的, 敌对的, 相反的, 逆的；[法] 相反的, 敌对的, 逆的

words.root: ad-（向）+ vers（转）→ 转向对面→不利的
exs: Adverse weather delayed the rescue operation for hours. 恶劣天气使救援行动延误了数小时。
The company suffered losses, facing adverse market conditions abroad. 公司遭受了损失，因为它面临不利的海外市场条件。

defs.cn: 空中的, 航空的, 空气的, 空想的
天线

words.root: aer（空气）+ -ial（的）→ 空中的
exs: The aerial photographs revealed hidden paths in the forest. 航拍照片揭示了森林中隐藏的小路。
Aerial surveys, conducted by drones, help farmers monitor crop health. 由无人机进行的空中勘测帮助农民监测作物健康状况。

defs.cn: 航天空间, 航天技术

words.root: aero（空气）+ space（空间）→ 航空航天
exs: The aerospace exhibition attracted thousands of engineering students. 航空航天展览吸引了数千名工科学生。
Aerospace engineers, designing reusable rockets, aim to lower launch costs. 设计可复用火箭的航空航天工程师旨在降低发射成本。

defs.cn: 美学的, 审美的, 有美感的

words.root: aesth（感觉）+ -etic（的）→ 审美的
exs: The museum's aesthetic design impresses every visiting critic. 博物馆的审美设计令每位到访的评论家印象深刻。
The aesthetic choice, which surprised critics, reduced the room's practicality. 这一令评论家惊讶的审美选择降低了房间的实用性。

defs.cn: 情感的, 表达感情的；[医] 感情的, 情感的

words.root: affect（情感）+ -ive（形容词）→情感的
exs: The therapist noted the patient's flat affective responses during the session. 治疗师注意到患者在会谈期间情感反应平淡。
Feeling overwhelmed, she struggled to articulate her affective reactions to the news. 她感到不知所措，难以清楚表达自己对这则消息的情感反应。

defs.cn: 使紧密联系, 使附属, 接纳, 收养
发生联系, 参加

words.root: ad-（向）+ fil（儿子）→认作亲属→附属
exs: The agency will affiliate several local clinics with its network. 该机构将把几家本地诊所并入其网络。
After signing the contract, the startup will affiliate with a larger distributor. 签署合同后，这家初创公司将与一家更大的经销商建立附属关系。

defs.cn: 断言, 确认

words.root: ad-（向）+ firm（坚定）→断言
exs: The judge will affirm the witness's statement after careful review. 法官将在仔细审查后确认证人的陈述。
Despite public doubts, the minister will affirm that the policy continues. 尽管公众存疑，部长将确认这项政策继续实施。

defs.cn: 使苦恼, 折磨

words.root: ad-（向）+ flict（打击）→折磨
exs: A severe drought will afflict many farming villages next summer. 严重干旱将在明年夏天折磨许多农业村庄。
Living with chronic pain, he knows headaches will afflict him every morning. 长期受慢性疼痛困扰，他知道头痛每天都会折磨他。

defs.cn: 富裕, 丰富, 流注；[医] 丰富, 流入

words.root: ad-（向）+ flu（流）→富裕
exs: The old district displays affluence through its marble facades and gardens. 老街区通过大理石外墙和花园显示出富裕。
Having inherited a business, she enjoyed affluence but rarely felt content. 继承企业后，她生活富裕却很少感到满足。

defs.cn: 使恶化, 使更严重, 加重

words.root: ad-（向）+ grav（重）→加重
exs: Noise pollution will aggravate insomnia in densely populated urban neighborhoods. 噪声污染将加剧人口稠密城市社区的失眠。
Ignoring medical advice, the patient will aggravate his condition through excessive drinking. 无视医嘱，该患者将因过度饮酒加重病情。

defs.cn: 侵犯, 侵略；[医] 攻击

words.root: ad-（向）+ gress（步）→ 逼近 → 侵犯
exs: The sudden aggression shocked the small border village. 突然的侵略震惊了那个小边境村庄。
Officials condemned the aggression after troops crossed the disputed river. 官方在部队越过争议河流后谴责了这次侵略。

defs.cn: 激动, 焦虑, 煽动, 搅动, 摇动；[化] 搅拌; 搅拌作用

words.root: agit-（搅动）+ -ation → 骚动、焦虑
exs: The public agitation disrupted the quiet morning meeting. 公众的骚动扰乱了安静的晨会。
Workers felt agitation while waiting for the delayed wage payment. 工人在等待延迟发放工资时感到焦虑。

defs.cn: 令人愉快的, 同意的；[医] 佳适的

words.root: agree + -able → 令人愉快的、同意的
exs: The agreeable host offered us warm tea and biscuits. 和蔼的主人给我们端上热茶和饼干。
She found the plan agreeable because it saved time. 她觉得这个计划令人愉快，因为它节省时间。

defs.cn: interj. 唉

words.root: 感叹词，音似“唉啦死”→ 遗憾
exs: Alas, the old library closed its doors forever. 唉，那座老图书馆永远关门了。
Alas, having missed the final bus, they waited outside. 唉，错过末班公交后，他们只能在外面等。

defs.cn: 粘贴簿, 唱片套；[医] 白色物

words.root: alb-（白）+ -um → 白色物 → 相册/唱片套
exs: The album contains twelve nostalgic family photos and postcards. 这本粘贴簿里有十二张怀旧家庭照片和明信片。
She kept the album because it recorded family holidays. 她保留这本粘贴簿，因为它记录了家庭假期。

defs.cn: 队列, 结盟, 校正；[计] 校准; 对齐; 对准

words.root: ad-（向）+ line（线）+ -ment → 对齐
exs: The teacher corrected the students' alignment during the drill. 老师在训练中纠正了学生的队列。
Engineers checked the alignment before installing the new sensor. 工程师在安装新传感器前检查了校准。

defs.cn: 断言, 主张, 申辩；[法] 声明, 事实陈述, 断言

words.root: allege（宣称）+ -ation（名词）→ 断言/指控。
exs: The company denied the allegation about unsafe working conditions. 公司否认了关于工作条件不安全的指控。
Facing public pressure, the CEO rejected the allegation that the factory dumped toxic waste. 面对公众压力，首席执行官驳斥了工厂倾倒有毒废物的指控。

defs.cn: 宣称, 主张, 提出, 断言；[法] 断言, 指称, 指证

words.root: ad-（向）+ leg（说/法）→ 宣称/指称。
exs: The witness alleged a serious security breach during the trial. 证人在庭审中指控存在严重的安全漏洞。
Alleging fraud, the shareholders demanded an independent audit of the financial records. 股东们指控存在欺诈，要求对财务记录进行独立审计。

defs.cn: 忠贞, 效忠

words.root: ligare（绑）+ -ance → 被绑住的忠诚。
exs: Many citizens pledged allegiance to the new constitution. 许多公民宣誓效忠新宪法。
The soldiers, refusing to betray their country, demonstrated unwavering allegiance during the crisis. 士兵们拒绝背叛国家，在危机中表现出坚定不移的忠诚。

defs.cn: 减轻, 使缓和

words.root: al-（向）+ levi（轻）→ 使变轻 → 减轻。
exs: The new policy helped alleviate severe housing shortages. 新政策帮助缓解了严重的住房短缺。
By subsidizing local farms, the government aimed to alleviate food price increases. 通过补贴当地农场，政府旨在缓解食品价格上涨。

defs.cn: 联盟, 联合；[法] 同盟, 联盟, 联姻

words.root: ally（联合）+ -ance → 联盟。
exs: The two universities formed a research alliance last month. 两所大学上月建立了研究联盟。
Hoping to attract investors, the startup entered an alliance with a logistics giant. 为了吸引投资者，这家初创公司与一家物流巨头结成联盟。

defs.cn: 联盟的, 联姻的, 联系起来的

words.root: ally（结盟）+ -ed → 联盟的。
exs: The allied forces secured the bridge before dawn. 盟军在黎明前控制了桥梁。
Allied with several hospitals, the agency expanded vaccination programs. 该机构与多家医院合作，扩大了疫苗接种项目。

defs.cn: 分派, 分配；[计] 分配

words.root: al-（向）+ loc（地方）→放到指定地方→分配
exs: The university will allocate extra funding to the rural research team next semester. 大学下学期将把额外资金分配给农村研究团队。
To reduce waste, the committee allocated remaining supplies to hospitals that needed them most. 为减少浪费，委员会把剩余物资分配给了最需要的医院。

defs.cn: 津贴, 零用钱, 限额, 折扣, 允许
定量供应

words.root: allow（允许）+ -ance→允许给的额度/津贴
exs: The government gives a monthly allowance to students from low-income families. 政府每月给低收入家庭学生发放津贴。
Having saved enough, the teenager received a small allowance for weekend expenses. 攒够钱后，青少年得到了一小笔零用钱用于周末开销。

defs.cn: 同盟者, 同盟国, 助手
使联盟, 使联合, 使有关系
结盟

words.root: al-（向）+ lig（绑）→绑在一起→结盟
exs: The small country sought an ally to strengthen its border defenses. 小国寻找盟友以加强边境防御。
Wanting to enter overseas markets, the firm chose a local ally. 为进入海外市场，公司选择了一个当地盟友。

defs.cn: 变更, 改动；[医] 变更

words.root: alter（改变）+ -ation→改动
exs: The tailor made a quick alteration to the wedding dress. 裁缝对婚纱做了快速修改。
After the client requested changes, the architect approved an alteration to the floor plan. 客户提出改动后，建筑师批准了对平面图的修改。

defs.cn: 交替的, 轮流的, 间隔的
轮流, (使)交替

words.root: alter（另一个）+ -nate→一个接一个→交替
exs: The two nurses worked alternate shifts during the flu outbreak. 两名护士在流感爆发期间轮流值班。
To keep the audience engaged, the director alternated scenes of comedy and tragedy. 为保持观众投入，导演交替安排喜剧和悲剧场景。

defs.cn: 大使；[法] 大使, 使节, 代理

words.root: amb-（周围）+ act（行动）→奔走办事→大使
exs: The ambassador delivered a formal speech at the international summit yesterday. 大使昨天在国际峰会上发表了正式演讲。
Having served for years, the ambassador negotiated a treaty that eased trade tensions. 任职多年后，大使谈判促成了一项缓解贸易紧张局势的条约。

defs.cn: 周围的
周围环境

words.root: ambi-（周围）+ ent（形容词）→ 周围的
exs: The ambient noise in the cafe disturbed my reading. 咖啡馆里的环境噪音干扰了我的阅读。
Ambient lighting, carefully chosen for the museum, enhances visitors' experience without disturbing the artworks. 精心选择的博物馆环境照明在不干扰展品的情况下提升观众体验。

defs.cn: 不明确, 含糊；[计] 二义性; 多义性

words.root: ambi-（两边）+ -ity（名词）→ 两可性
exs: The contract's ambiguity caused a serious dispute between the two companies last month. 合同中的含糊之处上个月导致两家公司发生严重纠纷。
The ambiguity in the instructions led students to submit projects that did not meet the requirements. 指令中的含糊导致学生提交了不符合要求的项目。

defs.cn: 不明确的, 模棱两可的；[法] 意思含糊的, 模棱两可的, 暧昧的

words.root: ambi-（两边）+ ag（做）+ -uous → 模棱两可
exs: His ambiguous reply left everyone uncertain about the final decision. 他含糊的回答让每个人对最终决定感到不确定。
The ambiguous wording, intentionally left by the negotiator, allowed both sides to claim victory. 谈判者故意保留的含糊措辞使双方都能宣称胜利。

defs.cn: 赔偿；[经] 赔偿

words.root: a-（加强）+ mend（修补）→ 补救
exs: The company made amends through a full refund and a free service. 该公司通过全额退款和免费服务进行了补救。
He tried to make amends for the mistake that had damaged his reputation. 他试图弥补损害其声誉的错误。

defs.cn: 在其间, 在其中；[经] 在...中

words.root: a-（在）+ mid（中间）→ 在其间
exs: The old temple stands amid dense bamboo forests near the quiet mountain village. 这座古老寺庙坐落在宁静山村附近的茂密竹林中。
Amid the heavy rain, the volunteers continued delivering supplies to families who were stranded. 大雨中，志愿者继续向被困家庭运送物资。

defs.cn: 大量的, 充足的, 丰富的

words.root: ambi-（周围）+ ple（填满）→ 充足
exs: The hotel offers ample parking spaces for guests with large vehicles. 这家酒店为驾驶大型车辆的客人提供充足停车位。
Ample evidence, carefully collected during the investigation, convinced the jury that the defendant was guilty. 调查期间精心收集的充分证据让陪审团相信被告有罪。

defs.cn: 广阔, 充足, 幅度；[化] 振幅

words.root: ample广阔+-tude名词→幅度
exs: The earthquake's amplitude caused visible cracks along the old highway. 地震的幅度使老公路沿线出现明显裂缝。
Because the signal amplitude dropped suddenly, the monitor alarmed the technician. 由于信号幅度突然下降，监视器向技术员发出警报。

defs.cn: 兴味, 娱乐, 消遣；[法] 娱乐, 娱乐活动

words.root: amuse逗乐+ment名词→娱乐
exs: The children's amusement filled the park with bright laughter every afternoon. 孩子们的娱乐让公园每天下午充满欢快的笑声。
Watching the clumsy magician, the audience burst into amusement despite the rain. 看着笨拙的魔术师，观众尽管下雨仍大笑起来。

defs.cn: 类似的, 相似的；[医] 类似的, 类同的

words.root: ana-相应+logos比例→类似的
exs: The new policy is analogous to the old rule in its strict limits. 新政策在严格限制方面类似旧规定。
Although the species evolved separately, their wings are analogous for flight. 虽然这些物种独立进化，它们的翅膀在飞行功能上类似。

defs.cn: 类似物, 相似情况；[医] 类似物, 同型物, 相似器官, 同功异质体

words.root: analog变体→类似物/模拟物
exs: The tablet is a modern analogue of the ancient wax writing board. 平板电脑是古代蜡写板的现代类似物。
Designed as an analogue, the circuit imitates the original system's behavior. 作为模拟物设计，该电路模仿原始系统的行为。

defs.cn: 相似, 类似；[计] 模拟

words.root: ana-相应+logos比例→类比
exs: The analogy between hearts and pumps clarified the difficult biology lesson. 心脏与水泵的类比使困难的生物课变得清晰。
Comparing the brain to a computer, the professor explained the analogy well. 把大脑比作计算机，教授很好地解释了这一类比。

defs.cn: 分析者, 精神分析学家；[化] 分析员; 化验员

words.root: analyze分析+ist人→分析者
exs: The financial analyst reviewed the quarterly report before the board meeting. 财务分析师在董事会前审阅了季度报告。
Because the data looked suspicious, the analyst requested a second investigation. 由于数据可疑，分析师要求再次调查。

defs.cn: 分析的, 善于分析的, 解析的；[医] 分析的

words.root: ana-（分开）+lytic（分解）→分解分析→分析的
exs: The report offers an analytic overview of consumer spending trends across major metropolitan regions. 该报告提供了主要大都市地区消费支出趋势的分析概览。
Analyzing survey data, the team discovered that analytic models predicted voting behavior more accurately than intuition did. 通过分析调查数据，团队发现分析模型比直觉更准确地预测了投票行为。

defs.cn: 分析的, 善于分析的, 解析的；[机] 分析的

words.root: ana-（分）+lytic（解）+al→分析的
exs: Her analytical skills helped the committee identify the hidden flaws in the proposed urban policy. 她的分析能力帮助委员会发现了所提议城市政策中的隐藏缺陷。
By comparing historical records, scholars concluded that analytical methods can reveal patterns invisible to casual observers. 通过比较历史记录，学者们得出结论：分析方法能够揭示随意观察者看不到的规律。

defs.cn: 周年纪念

words.root: ann-（年）+vers（转）→周年
exs: The museum celebrated its twentieth anniversary with a special exhibition of restored ancient manuscripts. 该博物馆以一场修复古代手稿特别展览庆祝其二十周年。
Families gathered outside the cathedral, remembering the anniversary when their community first rebuilt the school. 家人们聚集在大教堂外，纪念他们的社区首次重建学校的那个周年。

defs.cn: 一年一次, 每年；[经] 年度的, 每年的

words.root: ann-（年）+ual+ly→每年
exs: The university publishes its research findings annually for public feedback. 该大学每年公布其研究发现，供公众反馈。
Companies must submit these financial statements annually, which keeps market information transparent for investors. 公司必须每年提交这些财务报表，这使市场信息对投资者透明。

defs.cn: 阳极；[化] 阳极; 正极

words.root: ana-（向上）+odos（路）→阳极
exs: The zinc anode dissolves gradually during the battery's long discharge cycle. 锌阳极在电池长时间放电过程中逐渐溶解。
Because the anode releases electrons, corrosion can weaken the metal structure over time. 由于阳极释放电子，腐蚀会随时间削弱金属结构。

defs.cn: 姓氏不详的, 无名的, 无特色的；[计] 无记录

words.root: an-（无）+onym（名）→匿名的
exs: An anonymous donor gave the library enough money to purchase rare historical maps. 一位匿名捐赠者给了图书馆足够的钱购买稀有的历史地图。
The anonymous message, written in broken English, made investigators doubt its foreign origin. 这条匿名信息用破碎的英语写成，使调查者怀疑其外国来源。

defs.cn: 南极的, 南极地带的
南极地区

words.root: anti-（相对）+ arktos（北）→南极
exs: The antarctic expedition faced extreme cold and strong winds. 南极探险队遭遇了极端寒冷和强风。
Researchers studying the antarctic ice sheet warned that melting could raise sea levels. 研究南极冰盖的科学家警告说，融化可能使海平面上升。

defs.cn: 天线, 触须, 触角；[化] 天线

words.root: 像头上两根小天线，接收信号或气味
exs: The old television antenna needs replacing after the storm. 暴风雨后，旧电视天线需要更换。
Insects use their sensitive antennae to detect chemical signals in the air. 昆虫用灵敏的触角探测空气中的化学信号。

defs.cn: 古董, 古物
古老的, 古风的, 旧式的, 过时的

words.root: ante（前）→以前的→古老的/古董
exs: The antique clock in the hallway still keeps perfect time. 走廊里的古董钟仍然走时精准。
She collected antique books that had been damaged by dampness. 她收集了被潮气损坏的古董书。

defs.cn: 不爱社交的, 反社会的, 有害于公众利益的；[医] 不喜社交的

words.root: anti-（反对）+ social（社会）→反社会
exs: His antisocial behavior made neighbors avoid his house. 他的反社会行为让邻居们避开他家。
Teenagers who stay isolated for months may develop antisocial habits. 长期自我隔离的青少年可能养成反社会习惯。

defs.cn: 有感染力的, 动人的, 恳求的

words.root: appeal（呼吁）+ -ing（令人...的）→动人的
exs: The charity poster had an appealing image of a child. 慈善海报有一幅动人的儿童画面。
Hearing the appealing plea, many donors contributed to the shelter. 听到那恳求般的呼吁，许多捐赠者向收容所捐款。

defs.cn: 附录, 附加物, 阑尾；[化] 增补

words.root: ad-（向）+ pend（挂）→附加物→附录/阑尾
exs: The textbook's appendix contains several useful vocabulary lists. 这本教科书的附录包含几个有用的词汇表。
Doctors removed the inflamed appendix before it burst. 医生在阑尾破裂前切除了发炎的阑尾。

defs.cn: 拍手喝彩, 称赞, 赞同

words.root: ap-向+plaud拍手→鼓掌称赞
exs: The audience applauded the young pianist after her brilliant performance. 观众在她精彩演出后为年轻钢琴家鼓掌。
Applauding the proposal, many delegates argued that it would reduce carbon emissions effectively. 许多代表称赞该提案，认为它能有效减少碳排放。

defs.cn: 评价, 估价；[经] 评价, 评估

words.root: ap-向+price价格→估价
exs: The bank delayed the appraisal despite the surveyor's urgent report. 尽管调查员提交紧急报告，银行仍推迟评估。
Appraising the artwork carefully, the expert noted that its value had doubled. 专家仔细评估艺术品，指出其价值已翻倍。

defs.cn: 评价, 估价；[经] 评价, 鉴定

words.root: ap-向+price价格→估价
exs: Teachers appraise students' progress through weekly writing portfolios and classroom observation. 教师通过每周写作档案和课堂观察评价学生进步。
The manager appraised the project, warning that rising costs could threaten delivery. 经理评估项目，警告成本上升可能威胁交付。

defs.cn: 可感知的, 可评估的

words.root: appreciate评估+-able能→可感知
exs: The city saw an appreciable improvement in air quality after stricter emission controls. 更严排放控制后，城市空气质量有可感知改善。
Having studied the data, analysts confirmed an appreciable decline in housing prices. 研究数据后，分析师确认房价有可评估的下降。

defs.cn: 感激, 赏识, 鉴别；[经] 涨价, 增值

words.root: ap-向+preci价值+-ation→赏识
exs: Her appreciation of classical music grew during the university's summer concert series. 在大学夏季音乐会系列中，她对古典音乐的鉴赏力增长。
Appreciating his colleagues' support, he sent a handwritten note to each team. 感念同事支持，他给每队寄手写便条。

defs.cn: 有...倾向的, 易于的, 恰当的, 聪明的；[计] 自动数控语言, 自动图象传输, 自动程序控制, 自动程序设计工具

words.root: apt适合→恰当；易于
exs: He is apt to forget his keys on busy mornings. 忙碌早晨他容易忘带钥匙。
An apt response can defuse tension before the argument escalates further. 恰当的回应能在争执进一步升级前缓解紧张。

defs.cn: 弧, 弧形, 弓形, 弧光；[化] 弧

words.root: arc=拉丁arcus弧；像弯弓
exs: The arc of the bridge reflected softly on the calm river. 桥的弧形柔和地倒映在平静的河面上。
The engineer calculated the arc length, considering the load, before approving the design. 工程师在批准设计前，考虑了负荷，计算了弧长。

defs.cn: 拱门, 拱形, 足弓
使成弓形
拱起, 成弓形
主要的, 调皮的, 傲慢无礼的, 狡猾的

words.root: arch=拉丁arcus拱形；门洞
exs: The old stone arch stands quietly beside the narrow village street. 古老的石拱门静静地立在狭窄的村街旁。
The arch, built over the canal, supports the weight of the bridge. 建在运河上的拱门支撑着桥的重量。

defs.cn: 北极的, 极寒的
北极圈, 北极

words.root: arctic=希腊arktos熊→熊座→极寒
exs: The arctic wind cut through his coat during the early morning hike. 清晨徒步时，北极的寒风刺穿了他的外套。
Researchers studying the arctic ice recorded unusual changes in sea temperature. 研究北极冰层的研究人员记录了海水温度的异常变化。

defs.cn: 排列, 衣服, 大批, 军队
布署, 打扮, 排列；[计] 数组; 阵列

words.root: a+ray（光线）→光线排成阵列
exs: The museum showed an impressive array of ancient coins to visitors. 博物馆向参观者展示了令人印象深刻的古代钱币阵列。
A colorful array of fabrics, displayed by the vendor, attracted many tourists. 小贩展示的一排彩色布料吸引了许多游客。

defs.cn: 自大的, 傲慢的

words.root: ar-向+rog要求→总要求服从→傲慢
exs: The arrogant manager ignored the junior staff's reasonable suggestions in the meeting. 傲慢的经理在会议上忽视了年轻职员的合理建议。
Arrogant people, believing themselves superior, often offend colleagues without realizing it. 傲慢的人自视甚高，常常冒犯同事而不自知。

defs.cn: 发音清晰的, 口才好的
明白地说, 以关节连接, 使成为系统的整体

words.root: art=关节+ate→连接关节→清晰表达
exs: The articulate witness described the accident clearly despite her trembling voice. 口齿清晰的证人尽管声音颤抖，仍清楚描述了事故。
Students must articulate their ideas, supporting them with concrete examples. 学生必须清楚表达观点，并用具体例子加以支持。

defs.cn: 上升, 追溯, 登高
攀登

words.root: ad-（向）+scand（爬）→ 上升
exs: The hikers ascend the steep trail before dawn. 登山者在黎明前沿陡峭小径向上攀登。
As they ascend the mountain, the air becomes thinner and colder. 当他们向山上攀登时，空气变得越来越稀薄寒冷。

defs.cn: 确定, 查明；[法] 查明, 弄清, 确定

words.root: ad-（加强）+certain（确定）→ 查明
exs: The investigators ascertain the truth by examining security camera footage. 调查人员通过检查监控录像来查明真相。
To ascertain the cause of the outage, engineers reviewed every server log. 为了查明故障原因，工程师们检查了每一条服务器日志。

defs.cn: 向岸, 在岸上

words.root: a-（在/向）+shore（岸）→ 上岸
exs: The sailors carried fresh water ashore before setting sail. 水手们在起航前把淡水运上岸。
Once the passengers stepped ashore, they found a bustling harbor market. 乘客们一上岸，就发现了一个热闹的港口市场。

defs.cn: 热望, 志向, 渴望；[医] 吸入; 吸[引], 吸引术

words.root: ad-（向）+spir（呼吸）→ 热望/吸入
exs: Her main aspiration is to become a pediatric doctor in rural areas. 她的主要志向是成为农村地区的一名儿科医生。
Pursuing his career aspiration, he overcame financial setbacks and family pressure. 在追求职业志向的过程中，他克服了经济困难和家庭压力。

defs.cn: 驴, 傻瓜, 笨蛋, 屁股；[计] 模拟仿真系统

words.root: 驴固执→傻瓜；俚语指屁股
exs: The stubborn ass refused to move despite the farmer's gentle urging. 那头固执的驴尽管农夫温和催促仍拒绝移动。
Don't be such an ass; apologize sincerely before the meeting ends. 别这么蠢；在会议结束前真诚道歉。

defs.cn: 暗杀, 行刺；[法] 暗杀, 行刺, 中伤

words.root: assassin（刺客）+ -ate→ 暗杀
exs: The dictator was assassinated by a former bodyguard in a crowded square. 独裁者在拥挤的广场被一名前保镖暗杀。
After plotting for months, the rebels attempted to assassinate the visiting minister. 策划数月后，叛军试图暗杀到访的部长。

defs.cn: 攻击, 袭击
袭击, 攻击
发动攻击

words.root: as-(朝向)+salt(跳)→扑向→袭击
exs: The sudden assault on the border checkpoint forced soldiers to withdraw. 对边境检查站的突然袭击迫使士兵撤退。
Having been wounded in an armed assault, the officer still guided civilians to safety. 在武装袭击中受伤后，这名军官仍引导平民到达安全地点。

defs.cn: 主张, 坚称, 断言；[法] 宣称, 断言, 维护

words.root: as-(朝向)+sert(连接)→把话接上→断言
exs: The witness asserted his innocence despite the overwhelming evidence. 证人尽管证据确凿，仍坚称自己无罪。
Asserting that the contract was unfair, the employee refused to sign it. 员工声称合同不公平，拒绝签字。

defs.cn: 武断的, 过分自信的；[法] 断言的

words.root: assert(断言)+ive(形容词)→爱断言→武断
exs: An assertive tone can make the presentation sound more confident. 果断的语气能让演示听起来更自信。
Being overly assertive, he interrupted colleagues before they finished speaking. 由于过于武断，他在同事说完前就打断了他们。

defs.cn: 评估, 估定, 评定的款额；[化] 评估

words.root: assess(评估)+ment(名词)→评估结果
exs: The tax assessment surprised many small business owners this quarter. 本季度的税款评估让许多小企业主感到惊讶。
After completing the risk assessment, engineers redesigned the drainage system. 完成风险评估后，工程师重新设计了排水系统。

defs.cn: 使同化, 吸收, 使相拟, 把...比作
被吸收, 被同化

words.root: as-(朝向)+simil(相同)→使相同→同化
exs: Immigrants gradually assimilate into the local culture through daily interaction. 移民通过日常交往逐渐融入当地文化。
Having assimilated the technical terms, the translator completed the project early. 吸收了专业术语后，译者提前完成了项目。

defs.cn: 同化, 同化作用, 吸收；[化] 同化; 同化作用

words.root: assimilate(同化)+ation(名词)→同化过程
exs: Cultural assimilation often changes family traditions within two generations. 文化同化往往在两代人内改变家庭传统。
Having studied assimilation, she explained how language changes after migration. 研究同化后，她解释了移民后语言如何变化。

defs.cn: 保证, 把握, 信心, 保险；[经] 保证, 担保, 保险

words.root: as-(向)+sure(确定)→使人确定→保证
exs: Her calm voice gave nervous passengers a quiet assurance about the delayed flight. 她平静的声音让紧张的乘客对延误航班感到安心。
The bank required assurance that the borrower had a stable income before approving the loan. 在批准贷款前，银行要求借款人有稳定收入的保证。

defs.cn: 惊异, 惊愕, 使人惊异的事物

words.root: 联想：像被巨石砸中，目瞪口呆→惊异
exs: The magician's final trick filled the entire audience with genuine astonishment. 魔术师的最后一个把戏让全场观众感到真正的惊讶。
We watched in astonishment as the tiny seedling split the concrete pavement. 我们惊讶地看着那株小苗裂开了混凝土地面。

defs.cn: 运动的

words.root: athl-竞赛+-ic→竞赛的→运动的
exs: The athletic student won the hundred-meter dash during the school sports meeting. 那名运动型学生在学校运动会中赢得了百米短跑。
Athletic training requires discipline, especially when athletes compete in cold, rainy weather. 运动训练需要纪律，尤其是在寒冷多雨的天气中比赛时。

defs.cn: 连接, 附属物, 连接物, 爱慕；[计] 附加, 附件

words.root: at-(向)+tach(固定)→附着→附件/依恋
exs: The email attachment contained the signed lease agreement and two scanned receipts. 邮件附件包含已签署的租赁协议和两张扫描收据。
Feeling a strong attachment to his hometown, he declined the overseas promotion. 由于对家乡怀有强烈依恋，他拒绝了海外升职的机会。

defs.cn: 出席, 出席的人数, 照料；[法] 管理, 照料, 资助

words.root: attend(出席)+ance→出席/照料
exs: Attendance at the seminar dropped sharply after the unexpected power outage. 在意外停电后，研讨会的出席人数急剧下降。
The teacher records attendance by checking each student's name before the class begins. 老师在上课前通过核对每个学生的姓名来记录出勤。

defs.cn: 随从, 侍者, 出席者
侍候的, 伴随的, 出席的, 在场的

words.root: attend(照料)+ant人→侍者/随从
exs: The flight attendant handed warm towels to every passenger during the long journey. 长途飞行中，空乘人员给每位乘客递上热毛巾。
Having worked as a station attendant for years, she handled complaints calmly. 做车站工作人员多年后，她冷静地处理投诉。

defs.cn: [古]注意的, 留意的

words.root: at-(向)+tent(伸)→心伸向目标→注意
exs: The archivist was attent throughout the restoration of the medieval manuscript. 档案管理员在整个中世纪手稿修复过程中都很留意。
Attent to every detail, the curator recorded the manuscript's faded annotations. 留意每个细节，策展人记录了手稿褪色的批注。

defs.cn: 代理人, 律师；[经] 律师, 代理人

words.root: at-(向)+turn(转)→受托转办→代理人/律师
exs: The attorney filed the patent application before the federal deadline. 律师在联邦截止日期前提交了专利申请。
Having reviewed the contract, the attorney warned the client about hidden liabilities. 审阅合同后，律师提醒客户注意隐藏的责任。

defs.cn: 增加, 增长；[计] 增加; 增量; 添加

words.root: aug-(增加)+-ment(动作)→增加
exs: The company augmented its research team with two data scientists. 该公司用两名数据科学家扩充了研究团队。
By augmenting the dataset, the model improved its prediction accuracy. 通过扩充数据集，模型提高了预测准确率。

defs.cn: 可靠的, 可信的, 真正的；[法] 被认证的, 确认的, 可信的

words.root: auth-(作者/权威)+-entic→出自权威→真正的
exs: The museum displayed an authentic Qing dynasty bronze vessel. 博物馆展出了一件真正的清代青铜器。
Experts verified that the signature was authentic after examining the paper. 专家检查纸张后确认签名是真实的。

defs.cn: vi. (使)自动化；[计] 自动化

words.root: auto-(自动)+-ate(使)→使自动化
exs: The factory automated its assembly line to reduce labor costs. 该工厂使装配线自动化以降低人工成本。
Automating repetitive tasks, the software frees engineers for creative work. 自动化重复任务后，软件让工程师专注于创造性工作。

defs.cn: 有用, 有利
有利于
效用, 利益

words.root: a-(向)+val(价值)→有用/有利
exs: The new policy will avail little without public cooperation. 没有公众合作，新政策几乎没有用处。
All his efforts availed nothing when the storm damaged the crops. 风暴毁坏庄稼时，他所有努力都无济于事。

defs.cn: 有效性, 可利用性, 可利用的人；[计] 有效性; 可用性

words.root: avail（有用）+ ability（能力）→ 可用性
exs: The availability of clean water remains a major concern in many rural areas. 清洁水的可用性仍是许多农村地区的主要问题。
Researchers are checking whether the availability of vaccines can be improved before winter. 研究人员正在检查疫苗的可用性能否在冬季前得到改善。

defs.cn: 转开, 避免, 防止

words.root: a-（离开）+ vert（转）→ 转开→避免
exs: The new policy averted a serious financial crisis last year. 新政策去年避免了一场严重的金融危机。
By reducing emissions, countries can avert more severe climate impacts. 通过减少排放，各国可以避免更严重的气候影响。

defs.cn: 轴的, 成轴的, 轴向的；[医] 轴的, 中轴的

words.root: axis（轴）+ -al（形容词）→ 轴向的
exs: The axial load on the bridge exceeded the safety limit. 桥梁上的轴向载荷超过了安全限值。
Engineers inspected the axial shaft, which had begun to vibrate abnormally. 工程师检查了开始异常振动的轴向轴。

defs.cn: 轴, 车轴；[电] 轴

words.root: 与axis同源，指轮轴
exs: The truck’s rear axle broke during the mountain climb. 卡车后轴在爬山时断了。
Mechanics replaced the axle after the wheel suddenly detached. 车轮突然脱落后，机械师更换了车轴。

defs.cn: 脊椎, 志气, 骨干, 支柱；[计] 主干网, 主干网点

words.root: back（背）+ bone（骨）→ 脊骨→支柱
exs: The backbone of the network supports thousands of users daily. 网络主干每天支持数千名用户。
Having a strong backbone, he refused to yield to pressure. 他因为有坚强的脊梁，拒绝向压力屈服。

defs.cn: 熏猪肉；[机] 腌肉

words.root: 古法语 bacon（腌猪肉）→ 培根
exs: She bought a package of bacon for breakfast. 她买了一包培根当早餐。
The bacon sizzled in the pan while eggs cooked nearby. 鸡蛋在旁边煮着，培根在锅里滋滋作响。

defs.cn: 细菌；[医] [无芽胞]杆菌属

words.root: bacterio-（杆菌）+ -um（单数）→ 细菌单数
exs: A single bacterium can multiply rapidly in warm, moist laboratory conditions. 单个细菌在温暖潮湿的实验室条件下可迅速繁殖。

defs.cn: 徽章, 标记；[计] 标记

words.root: 挂胸前的小牌，标记身份

The police officer showed his badge before entering the building. 警官在进入大楼前出示了徽章。

defs.cn: 困惑, 为难, 使挫折
徒作挣扎
迷惑, 挡板

words.root: 挡板挡路，令人困惑
exs: The locked door baffled the firefighters for several minutes. 紧锁的门让消防员困惑了几分钟。
Baffled by the puzzle, the student asked his teacher for help. 被谜题难住的学生向老师求助。

defs.cn: 饵
以饵引诱, 欺负
中途休息

words.root: 联想bite咬：饵引鱼咬钩
exs: A piece of bait lay on the wet rock near the tide. 一块鱼饵落在潮水附近的湿岩石上。

defs.cn: 秃头的, 光秃的, 单调的, 赤裸的
变秃

exs: The old man's bald head reflected sunlight during the long walk. 老人的秃头在漫长步行中反射阳光。
Bald after chemotherapy, he wore a hat to feel confident again. 化疗后变秃，他戴帽子以重新感到自信。

defs.cn: 芭蕾舞

words.root: bal-（跳舞）→ 芭蕾舞
exs: The ballet dancers rehearsed a difficult scene in the studio. 芭蕾舞演员在工作室排练一段高难度场景。
Ballet requires years of practice before performers can master graceful movements. 芭蕾需要多年练习，表演者才能掌握优雅动作。

defs.cn: 投票, 投票用纸, 抽签
投票, 抽签
投票选出, 拉选票

words.root: ball（球）+ -otta（小）→ 投球表决 → 投票。
exs: Voters submitted ballots through an online portal yesterday afternoon. 选民昨天下午通过在线投票平台提交了选票。
Because the election was close, officials recounted every ballot carefully. 因为选举结果接近，官员们仔细重新清点了每张选票。

defs.cn: 竹子；[医] 竹类

words.root: 谐音“斑竹”，一节一节，坚韧挺拔。
exs: The carpenter built a sturdy bamboo shelf for the small library. 木匠为那间小图书馆搭建了一个坚固的竹架。
Having survived the storm, the bamboo grove still stood beside the river. 挺过暴风雨后，那片竹林依然矗立在河边。

defs.cn: 绷带；[化] 帘布筒; 实心轮胎; 紧带; 绷带

words.root: band（带子）+ -age → 包扎用的带子。
exs: The nurse wrapped a clean bandage around the patient's injured wrist. 护士用一条干净的绷带包扎了病人受伤的手腕。
After checking the wound, the doctor applied a bandage to stop bleeding. 检查伤口后，医生用绷带包扎以止血。

defs.cn: 强盗

words.root: ban（放逐令）→ 被放逐者 → 强盗。
exs: A masked bandit robbed the rural post office last winter. 一名蒙面强盗去年冬天抢劫了那家乡村邮局。
The villagers fled when they heard that a bandit was approaching. 当村民听说有强盗靠近时，他们纷纷逃散。

defs.cn: 银行家, 庄家；[经] 银行业者, 银行家

words.root: bank（银行）+ -er（人）→ 经营银行者。
exs: The experienced banker approved the small business loan after careful review. 这位经验丰富的银行家经过仔细审核批准了那笔小企业贷款。
Working late at the branch, the banker prepared quarterly financial reports. 在分行加班到深夜，这位银行家准备了季度财务报告。

defs.cn: 破产者
破产的
使破产

words.root: bank（银行长凳）+ rupt（断）→ 破产。
exs: The old factory became bankrupt this month despite government support. 尽管有政府支持，这家老工厂本月还是破产了。
Although the company was bankrupt, its employees received unpaid wages. 尽管该公司已经破产，其员工仍收到了未付工资。

defs.cn: 破产者；[经] 破产, 倒闭

words.root: bank钱台+rupt断+cy→资金断裂→破产
exs: The company's bankruptcy shocked its loyal suppliers and employees. 公司破产令其忠诚供应商和员工震惊。
Facing bankruptcy, the manager cut costs by closing two factories. 面临破产，经理通过关闭两家工厂来削减成本。

defs.cn: 宴会

words.root: 大宴台摆满酒菜→banquet宴会
exs: The mayor hosted a formal banquet for visiting business leaders. 市长为来访的商界领袖举办了正式宴会。
Guests enjoyed speeches while they attended the charity banquet. 宾客在参加慈善宴会时欣赏了演讲。

defs.cn: 驳船
用船运输
蹒跚, 闯入

words.root: bar横木撑船→驳船；硬闯→蹒跚
exs: A narrow barge carried coal down the quiet river. 一艘窄驳船沿平静的河流运送煤炭。
He barged into the meeting, interrupting the important presentation. 他闯进会议，打断了重要的演示。

defs.cn: 大麦；[医] 大麦

words.root: 巴粒→大麦颗粒→barley
exs: The farmer planted barley in the fertile field near the town. 农民在城镇附近的肥沃田地里种大麦。
Barley grows well where summers are warm and winters are mild. 大麦在夏季温暖、冬季温和的地方生长良好。

defs.cn: 气压计；[化] 气压计

words.root: baro重/压+meter测→气压计
exs: The old barometer on the wall predicted the coming storm. 墙上那只旧气压计预示了即将到来的风暴。
Watching the barometer, the sailors guessed the weather would change. 看着气压计，水手们猜测天气将会变化。

defs.cn: 男爵；[法] 男爵, 贵族, 大王

words.root: 大霸主坐高椅→男爵/大王
exs: The wealthy baron owned a large estate beside the forest. 这位富有的男爵在森林旁拥有一大片庄园。
Having inherited the title, the baron managed several mines. 继承头衔后，男爵经营了几座矿。

defs.cn: 不育的, 贫瘠的
荒地

words.root: 联想bar（栅栏）围住荒地，寸草不生。
exs: The barren field produced no crops after months of drought. 干旱数月后，这片贫瘠的土地没有长出任何庄稼。
Barren soil, lacking nutrients, often forces farmers to abandon their ancestral lands. 贫瘠土壤缺乏养分，常迫使农民放弃祖辈的土地。

defs.cn: 地下室, 墙脚；[化] 地下室

words.root: base（基础）+ -ment → 建筑底部/墙脚 → 地下室
exs: The flooded basement damaged boxes of old family photographs. 被水淹没的地下室弄坏了整箱旧家庭照片。
Built under the house, the basement stores tools and seasonal decorations. 建在房屋下方，地下室存放工具和季节性装饰品。

defs.cn: 一次所烘的面包, 一次所制之量, 一组, 批, 成批, 分批
成批, 分批处理；[计] 一批

words.root: 联想一次烤出一炉面包→一批。
exs: The factory produced a batch of defective batteries last week. 工厂上周生产了一批有缺陷的电池。
Processing data in batches reduces memory pressure on the server. 分批处理数据可减轻服务器内存压力。

defs.cn: 集市, 市场, 义卖市场

words.root: 音译“巴扎”，中东集市。
exs: The old bazaar sells spices, carpets, and handmade silver jewelry. 老集市出售香料、地毯和手工银饰。
We bargained at the bazaar until the vendor lowered his price. 我们在集市讨价还价，直到小贩降价。

defs.cn: 珠子, 滴
用珠装饰
形成珠；[计] 珠

words.root: 联想念珠：每念一句拨一颗珠。
exs: A single bead of sweat rolled down his forehead. 一滴汗水从他额头滚下。
She decorated the vase with beads painted in bright colors. 她用涂成亮色的珠子装饰花瓶。

defs.cn: 举止, 轴承, 忍受, 关系, 意义, 方向, 生育；[化] 轴承

words.root: bear（承受）+ing→承受部件→轴承
exs: The machine's main bearing overheated and stopped the drill. 机器主轴承过热，使钻头停转。
Bearing heavy loads, the shaft requires regular lubrication. 承受重载时，轴需要定期润滑。

defs.cn: 甲虫, 大槌
快速移动
捶

words.root: 甲虫硬壳像小坦克，快速爬行。
exs: A shiny black beetle rested on the damp leaf after the morning rain. 一只闪亮的黑甲虫在晨雨后停歇在潮湿的叶片上。
When the gardener lifted the stone, a tiny beetle scurried into the dark soil. 当园丁搬开石头时，一只小甲虫迅速钻进了黑暗的泥土。

defs.cn: 受惠者, 受益人
受封的

words.root: bene-（好）+fic（做）→恩惠→受益人
exs: The beneficiary received a monthly pension after his father's death. 该受益人在父亲去世后每月领取养老金。
Anyone who becomes a beneficiary must provide proof of identity. 任何成为受益人的人都必须提供身份证明。

defs.cn: 善良的, 良性的；[医] 良性的

words.root: bene-（好）+gen（生）→好的生长→良性
exs: The doctor described the lump as benign and recommended a simple checkup. 医生称肿块是良性的，并建议做一次简单检查。
Although the tumor was benign, the patient felt anxious for weeks. 尽管肿瘤是良性的，患者仍焦虑了好几个星期。

defs.cn: 授予, 使用, 贮藏, 留宿

words.root: be-（加强）+stow（存放）→安放→授予
exs: The university bestowed an honorary degree on the retired scientist. 大学授予这位退休科学家荣誉学位。
Nature bestowed such beauty on the valley that tourists returned yearly. 大自然赋予山谷如此美景，游客每年都来。

defs.cn: 小心, 谨防

words.root: be-（加强）+ware（小心）→当心
exs: Beware of slippery tiles near the swimming pool entrance. 小心游泳池入口附近打滑的地砖。
Travelers should beware that pickpockets often target crowded subway stations. 旅客应当心，扒手经常盯上拥挤的地铁站。

defs.cn: 使迷惑, 使不知所措

words.root: be-（加强）+wild（狂野）→使迷乱
exs: The complex tax rules bewildered many small business owners. 复杂的税规让许多小企业主困惑。
Seeing the sudden price hike, customers were bewildered by the store's new policy. 看到价格突然上涨，顾客对商店的新政策感到困惑。

defs.cn: 有偏见的；[计] 边缘的

words.root: bias偏见+ -ed：被偏见影响→有偏见的。
exs: The judge's biased ruling disappointed both parties in the courtroom. 法官带有偏见的裁决让法庭上的双方都感到失望。
Biased by outdated data, the model misclassified many applicants. 由于受陈旧数据影响，模型错误分类了许多申请者。

defs.cn: 出价
命令, 吩咐, 请求, 表示, 宣布, 投标

words.root: bid古英biddan：请求/出价→投标
exs: The consortium submitted a bid for the municipal bridge project yesterday. 财团昨天为市政桥梁项目提交了投标。
Bidding for the infrastructure contract, the manager warned that aggressive pricing could undermine quality. 在竞标基础设施合同时，经理警告激进定价可能损害质量。

defs.cn: 生物技术

words.root: bio-（生命）+ tech（技术）→ 生物技术
exs: The biotech firm unveiled a vaccine candidate in Shanghai yesterday. 这家生物科技公司昨天在上海发布了一种候选疫苗。
Researchers, hoping to reduce costs, are using biotech tools to edit crop genomes. 研究人员希望降低成本，正利用生物技术工具编辑作物基因组。

defs.cn: 主教, (国际象棋中的)象, 热果子酒

words.root: epi-（在上）+skop（看）→监督者→主教。
exs: The bishop blessed the newly built chapel on Sunday. 主教在周日祝福了新建的小教堂。
Walking through the cathedral, the bishop greeted anxious parishioners. 主教穿过大教堂，问候焦虑的教区居民。

defs.cn: 苦味, 悲痛, 怨恨

words.root: bitter苦+ness名词后缀→苦味/怨恨
exs: The bitterness of the herbal medicine made the child cry loudly. 草药的苦味让孩子大哭起来。
Having lost his promotion, he felt bitterness toward the supervisor who favored his rival. 失去晋升机会后，他对偏袒对手的上级心怀怨恨。

defs.cn: 奇异的

words.root: 音近“比扎”，怪异得像被针扎
exs: The museum displayed bizarre artifacts from forgotten Pacific islands. 博物馆展出来自被遗忘的太平洋岛屿的奇异文物。
After seeing the bizarre weather pattern, residents canceled the outdoor festival. 看到奇异天气模式后，居民取消了户外节日。

defs.cn: 铁匠；[机] 铁匠

words.root: black（黑）+smith（工匠）→打铁弄黑→铁匠。
exs: The blacksmith forged a strong gate for the castle. 铁匠为城堡锻造了一扇坚固的大门。
Sparks flying, the blacksmith shaped hot iron into tools. 火花四溅，铁匠把烧热的铁锻造成工具。

defs.cn: 漂白
变白
漂白, 漂白剂

words.root: bleach古英bleacian：使白→漂白
exs: She used bleach to clean the white shirt after the dinner party. 晚宴后她用漂白剂清洗白衬衫。
Bleaching the old curtains, he realized sunlight had faded them beyond repair. 漂白旧窗帘时，他意识到阳光已让它们褪色到无法修复。

defs.cn: 萧瑟的, 荒凉的, 阴冷的

words.root: 联想 black（黑）：阴暗寒冷→荒凉
exs: The bleak hillside offered no shelter from winter winds. 荒凉山坡没有遮挡冬季寒风的地方。
Without sunlight, the bleak valley looked like a frozen wasteland. 没有阳光，阴冷的山谷看起来像一片冰冻荒地。

defs.cn: 眨眼, 闪亮
眨眼, 使闪亮
眨眼, 瞬间, 闪光, 闪烁；[计] 闪烁

words.root: 像灯blink一闪一闪→眨眼、闪烁。
exs: She did not blink during the tough interview. 她在艰难的采访中连眼睛都没眨一下。
Blinking twice, he pretended not to notice the mistake. 他眨了两下眼，假装没有注意到这个错误。

defs.cn: 金发的
白肤碧眼金发的人

words.root: blond法语金发→金发碧眼
exs: The blond girl wore a red scarf in the crowded market. 金发女孩在拥挤的市场里戴着红围巾。
Standing near the window, the blond teacher looked like a character from a classic film. 站在窗边，那位金发老师像经典电影里的角色。

defs.cn: 宽松的上衣

words.root: 法语 blouse（罩衫）→女式宽松上衣
exs: She wore a white blouse to the office meeting. 她穿一件白色宽松上衣参加办公室会议。
The blouse, designed for summer, feels light and breathable. 这件为夏季设计的宽松上衣感觉轻薄透气。

defs.cn: 大错, 大失策
失策, 跌跌撞撞地走, 犯错
做错

words.root: 撞bl到under桌下→犯大错。
exs: His careless blunder cost the team a valuable contract. 他粗心的大错让团队失去了一份宝贵合同。
Having blundered during the negotiation, he apologized sincerely. 他在谈判中犯了大错后，真诚地道歉了。

defs.cn: 钝的, 坦率的, 麻痹的

words.root: blunt钝→说话不绕弯/麻痹
exs: The blunt knife could not slice the fresh bread easily. 钝刀无法轻松切开新鲜面包。
Speaking bluntly, the editor said the article lacked evidence and clear logic. 编辑说话直率，认为文章缺乏证据和清晰逻辑。

defs.cn: 坦率地, 率直地

words.root: blunt（直率）+ -ly（副词）→坦率地
exs: The professor bluntly told students their drafts were weak. 教授坦率地告诉学生他们的初稿很薄弱。
Asked bluntly about delays, the manager admitted poor planning. 被坦率问及延误时，经理承认计划不周。

defs.cn: 使模糊, 弄脏
弄脏, 模糊

words.root: 墨一涂就blur→模糊、弄脏。
exs: Rain blurred the windshield during the mountain drive. 山区驾驶时，雨水使挡风玻璃变得模糊。
Tears blurring her vision, she could not read the letter. 泪水模糊了她的视线，她无法读那封信。

defs.cn: 脸红, 羞愧
弄成红色
脸红

words.root: blush联想脸颊红如花朵
exs: A sudden blush spread across her cheeks during the job interview. 求职面试时她脸颊突然泛起红晕。
Blushing at the compliment, he lowered his head and smiled shyly. 听到夸奖，他脸红，低下头害羞地笑了。

defs.cn: 煮器, 汽锅, 锅炉；[化] 锅炉

words.root: boil（煮沸）+ -er（器）→煮器/锅炉
exs: The factory installed a new boiler to save energy. 工厂安装了新锅炉以节约能源。
When the boiler failed, workers repaired it before dawn. 锅炉出故障时，工人们在黎明前修好了它。

defs.cn: 中产阶级分子, 商人, 资产阶级
中产阶级的, 平庸的
九点活字

words.root: bourg(城镇)+ois(居民)→市民→资产阶级
exs: The bourgeois shopkeeper valued stability over radical political change. 这位资产阶级店主重视稳定而非激进政治变革。
Seeing the factory's decline, the bourgeois investors chose cautious reinvestment rather than immediate closure. 看到工厂的衰落，资产阶级投资者选择谨慎再投资而非立即关闭。

defs.cn: 联合抵制
联合抵制

words.root: 人名Boycott遭集体拒绝→联合抵制
exs: The workers organized a boycott against the unfair factory rules. 工人们发起了抵制不公平工厂规定的行动。
Consumers boycotted the brand, believing it exploited local farmers. 消费者抵制该品牌，认为它剥削当地农民。

defs.cn: 支柱, 曲柄, 支撑, 一对
紧缚, 支撑, 激励
打起精神；[计] 花括号

words.root: brace：撑住；想象用支架撑住断骨。
exs: The surgeon braced the broken bone with a metal plate. 外科医生用金属板固定了断骨。
Bracing himself against the storm, the sailor tightened the ropes. 水手稳住身子，迎着暴风雨拉紧绳索。

defs.cn: 崩溃, 故障；[化] 事故; 击穿

words.root: break(破)+down(向下)→彻底破损→崩溃
exs: The breakdown of the generator delayed production by three hours. 发电机故障使生产延误了三个小时。
Having suffered a breakdown, the factory manager ordered an immediate safety review. 在发生故障后，工厂经理下令立即进行安全审查。

defs.cn: 贿赂
贿赂, 收买
行贿

words.root: 塞“币”求办事→贿赂
exs: The contractor tried to bribe the inspector with expensive gifts. 承包商试图用昂贵礼物贿赂检查员。
Having been offered a bribe, the official reported the incident immediately. 官员在收到贿赂提议后，立即上报了此事。

defs.cn: 新郎

words.root: bride（新娘）+ groom（迎亲男子）→ 新郎。
exs: The bridegroom greeted guests warmly at the wedding entrance. 新郎在婚礼入口处热情迎接宾客。
Standing beside the bride, the bridegroom whispered a quiet vow. 新郎站在新娘身旁，低声许下誓言。

defs.cn: 马勒, 约束；[医] 系带, 约束

words.root: bridle像缰绳勒住马→约束
exs: The bridle kept the restless horse steady during the crowded parade. 马勒让那匹不安分的马在拥挤游行中保持稳定。
Constrained by regulations, the company tried to bridle its rapid expansion. 受法规约束，公司试图限制其快速扩张。

defs.cn: 光亮, 明亮, 聪明；[计] 亮度

words.root: bright（明亮）+ -ness（名词）→亮度/聪明
exs: The screen's brightness adjusts automatically in different lighting conditions. 屏幕亮度会随不同光线条件自动调节。
Her brightness impressed the interviewer, especially when she explained the solution. 她的聪明给面试官留下深刻印象，尤其是在解释方案时。

defs.cn: 变宽, 扩大
放宽, 使扩大

words.root: broad（宽）+ en（使）→ 使变宽。
exs: The river broadens sharply near the estuary during heavy rain. 大雨期间，河流在河口附近迅速变宽。
Traveling abroad broadened her perspective on cultural differences. 出国旅行拓宽了她对文化差异的看法。

defs.cn: 浏览, 吃草
浏览, 吃草；[计] 浏览

words.root: 像山羊啃嫩枝→随意浏览网页
exs: The librarian taught students to browse the database efficiently. 图书管理员教学生高效地浏览数据库。
Browsing the catalog, the researcher found several rare manuscripts. 浏览目录时，研究者发现了几份珍稀手稿。

defs.cn: 残忍的, 野蛮的, 不讲理的

words.root: brute（野兽）+ -al→残忍野蛮
exs: The dictator's brutal policies destroyed many families in the region. 独裁者的残酷政策摧毁了该地区许多家庭。
Witnesses described a brutal attack that shocked the entire neighborhood. 目击者描述了一场震惊整个社区的野蛮袭击。

defs.cn: 佛教

words.root: Buddha（佛陀）+ ism（宗教）→ 佛教。
exs: Buddhism spread along trade routes across ancient Central Asia. 佛教沿贸易路线传播到古代中亚各地。
Practicing mindfulness, many people find Buddhism helpful for daily stress. 通过修习正念，许多人觉得佛教有助于缓解日常压力。

defs.cn: 水牛；[机] 水牛

words.root: 大牛扛犁，buffalo是水牛
exs: The water buffalo plowed the muddy field before sunrise. 水牛在日出前耕了泥泞的田地。
Riding the buffalo across the flooded village, the farmer rescued two children. 农民骑着水牛穿过被淹的村庄，救出了两个孩子。

defs.cn: 错误, 虫, 病菌, 缺陷, 窃听器, 癖好, 防盗报警器, 双座小汽车, 要人
装防盗报警器, 装窃听器, 激怒
捉虫, 暴突；[计] 缺点, 错误

words.root: 虫钻进机器→程序bug/窃听器
exs: The engineer fixed a critical bug before the software release. 工程师在软件发布前修复了一个严重缺陷。
A hidden bug caused the system to crash during the exam. 一个隐藏缺陷导致系统在考试期间崩溃。

defs.cn: 喇叭, 号角
吹号

words.root: bugle：像铜号；想象士兵吹号集合。
exs: The soldier sounded a bugle at dawn for morning drill. 士兵在黎明吹号角进行晨练。
Hearing the bugle, the troops assembled quickly on the parade ground. 听到号角声，部队迅速在操场集合。

defs.cn: 公告, 布告, 公报；[电] 电子布告栏

words.root: bull(泡泡/印章)+etin→盖印公告
exs: The bulletin announced the new office hours to all employees. 公告向全体员工宣布了新的办公时间。
Having read the bulletin, the committee postponed the scheduled vote. 读完公告后，委员会推迟了原定投票。

defs.cn: 撞击, 肿块
碰撞
撞, 颠簸而行

words.root: 砰一声撞出包→碰撞/肿块
exs: The car hit a bump and made the passengers uneasy. 汽车撞到路面上的凸起，使乘客感到不安。
While walking, she bumped into a stranger and apologized quickly. 走路时，她撞到一个陌生人并迅速道歉。

defs.cn: 官僚, 官吏；[法] 官僚主义, 官僚政治, 官僚机构

words.root: bureau（办公室）+ cracy（统治）→ 官僚机构。
exs: The bureaucracy delayed the permit for several frustrating weeks. 官僚机构把许可证拖延了好几个令人沮丧的星期。
Facing endless forms, applicants complained about the slow bureaucracy. 面对无尽的表格，申请人抱怨官僚机构效率低下。

defs.cn: 窃贼；[法] 夜盗, 窃贼, 盗窃者

words.root: burg（宅/城）→ 闯入宅中的人→窃贼
exs: A burglar stole several diamonds from the jewelry store last night. 一名窃贼昨晚从珠宝店偷走了几颗钻石。
The police arrested a burglar who had climbed through the kitchen window before dawn. 警方逮捕了一名在黎明前从厨房窗户爬入的窃贼。

defs.cn: 埋葬, 葬礼；[法] 埋葬, 葬礼

words.root: bury(埋)+-al(名词)→埋葬/葬礼。
exs: The burial took place at dawn beside the old church. 葬礼在黎明时于老教堂旁举行。
The burial, postponed by heavy rain, finally occurred on Tuesday. 因大雨推迟的葬礼最终在周二举行。

defs.cn: 火炉, 烧火的人；[化] 灯; 灯头; 烧嘴炉; 燃烧器; 燃烧炉

words.root: burn(燃烧)+-er(者/物)→燃烧器
exs: The gas burner in the laboratory must be cleaned after every experiment. 实验室里的燃气燃烧器每次实验后都必须清洁。
After noticing a faulty burner, the technician shut off the gas valve immediately. 发现燃烧器有故障后，技师立即关闭了燃气阀门。

defs.cn: 蒲式耳(容量单位)
修整(衣物)

words.root: 一筐谷物量词；筐形整衣→蒲式耳/修整
exs: Farmers sold a bushel of fresh corn at the weekend market. 农民们在周末市场卖了一蒲式耳新鲜玉米。
The tailor will bushel the coat, smoothing every loose thread before delivery. 裁缝将修整这件外套，在交付前抚平每一根松线。

defs.cn: 粗大的一头, 烟头, 靶, 笑柄；[医] 对核

words.root: 粗短一头；烟头、靶子都短粗。
exs: A cigarette butt lay near the bus stop bench. 一个烟头躺在公交站长椅旁。
After smoking indoors, he hid the butt in his pocket. 在室内抽完烟后，他把烟头藏进口袋。

defs.cn: 嗡嗡声, 流言
发出嗡嗡声, 说闲话
使嗡嗡叫, 散布

words.root: buzz拟声→蜂鸣；嗡嗡传开→流言
exs: The fluorescent lights buzzed softly in the empty lecture hall. 空教室里荧光灯轻轻嗡嗡作响。
The rumor buzzed through the office, making everyone whisper. 流言在办公室传开，人人都在低声议论。

defs.cn: 旁路
省略, 绕过, 忽视, 回避

words.root: by（旁边）+ pass（经过）→ 从旁经过→绕过
exs: Drivers can bypass the flooded road near the river. 司机可以绕过河边那条被水淹的路。
The committee decided to bypass the outdated rule, which had blocked many reforms. 委员会决定绕过过时的规则，该规则曾阻碍许多改革。

defs.cn: 结石；微积分学

words.root: calculus=小石子→算珠→微积分/结石。
exs: The doctor found a small calculus in his kidney. 医生发现他肾脏里有一小块结石。
Students who study calculus often struggle with limits. 学习微积分的学生常常在极限上感到吃力。

defs.cn: 口径测定, 刻度, 校准；[化] 校准

words.root: 校准仪器：调准刻度，cali像“卡里”
exs: The calibration of the thermometer took twenty minutes. 温度计的校准花了二十分钟。
Before using the scale, she completed the calibration according to the manual. 使用秤之前，她按说明书完成了校准。

defs.cn: 手杖, 细长的茎, 藤条
以杖击, 以藤编制

words.root: cane 本义藤条→细茎可制手杖，也作杖击
exs: The old man tapped his cane on the stone path. 老人用手杖轻敲石板路。
The teacher caned the student, who had repeatedly bullied classmates, in front of the blackboard. 老师在黑板前用藤杖打了那个屡次欺负同学的学生。

defs.cn: 能力, 性能, 约束力；[化] 能力

words.root: cap(容纳)+able+ity→能力/性能。
exs: The new drone has impressive capability in low light. 新无人机在弱光下拥有出色性能。
The team's capability to handle crises impressed investors. 团队处理危机的能力给投资者留下深刻印象。

defs.cn: 电容；[化] 电容

words.root: capac(容纳)+-ance→电容
exs: The capacitance of the circuit affects the charging speed. 电路的电容影响充电速度。
Measuring capacitance requires a multimeter and careful wiring. 测量电容需要万用表和仔细接线。

defs.cn: 电容器；[化] 电容器

words.root: capac（容量）+ -or→储电器件→电容器
exs: The engineer tested the capacitor in the laboratory yesterday. 工程师昨天在实验室测试了电容器。
The capacitor, which stores electrical energy, powers the camera flash when needed. 储存电能的电容器在需要时为相机闪光灯供电。

defs.cn: 岬, 海角, 披肩, 斗蓬

words.root: cape像C形：披肩绕肩，岬角入海。
exs: The ship rounded the rocky cape before sunset. 船在日落前绕过那座岩石岬角。
Wearing a red cape, the actor looked heroic. 披着红斗篷，这位演员看起来英勇无比。

defs.cn: 胶囊, 蒴果, 瓶帽, 航天舱；[化] 胶囊剂

words.root: caps(容器)+-ule(小)→胶囊
exs: The doctor prescribed one capsule after each meal. 医生开药，每餐后服一粒胶囊。
The capsule, designed for slow release, dissolves gradually in the stomach. 这种缓释胶囊会在胃中逐渐溶解。

defs.cn: 卡通画, 漫画
画漫画

words.root: cart（纸/卡）+ -oon→纸上夸张画→漫画
exs: The cartoon on the front page mocked the mayor's empty promises. 头版上的漫画嘲笑了市长空洞的承诺。
Children gathered around the TV, watching a cartoon about a brave robot. 孩子们围在电视机旁，观看一部关于勇敢机器人的卡通片。

defs.cn: 弹药筒, 弹药, 一卷软片, 墨粉鼓；[计] 盒式磁带机

words.root: 画面：小筒装入设备，如弹筒/墨盒。
exs: The printer needs a fresh cartridge before Monday. 打印机在周一前需要更换新墨盒。
Loading the cartridge, she heard a soft click. 装入墨盒时，她听到一声轻微的咔哒。

defs.cn: 意外事故, 伤亡, 受害者；[化] 事故

words.root: casual(偶然)+-ty→意外伤亡
exs: The casualty list from the accident grew overnight. 事故伤亡名单在夜间增加。
The number of casualties, reported by officials, shocked the public. 官员报告的伤亡人数令公众震惊。

defs.cn: 目录, 大学情况一览
编入目录

words.root: cata-（向下）+leg（说/列）→目录
exs: The museum catalogue lists thousands of ancient coins from the Silk Road. 博物馆目录列出了来自丝绸之路的数千枚古币。
Researchers who catalogued the fragile documents discovered a hidden letter. 编目脆弱文献的研究人员发现了一封隐藏的信。

defs.cn: 触媒, 接触剂, 催化剂, 刺激因素, 促进因素；[计] 催化剂

words.root: cata-（向下）+ lysis（分解）→ 促成反应→催化剂
exs: The new policy acted as a catalyst for local economic growth. 新政策成为当地经济增长的催化剂。
By lowering trade barriers, the agreement served as a catalyst that encouraged cross-border investment. 通过降低贸易壁垒，该协议成为鼓励跨境投资的催化剂。

defs.cn: 大灾难, 大祸；[化] 突变

words.root: cata-（向下）+ strophe（转）→ 突转 → 灾难
exs: A sudden earthquake caused a catastrophe in the coastal town. 一场突发地震给沿海小镇造成了灾难。
The insurance company refused claims after the catastrophe destroyed homes. 灾难摧毁房屋后，保险公司拒绝理赔。

defs.cn: 提供饮食及服务, 投合, 迎合

words.root: 谐音“开特”→开特供，投合需求
exs: The hotel can cater for large wedding parties with outdoor dining. 这家酒店可提供户外用餐，满足大型婚礼派对需求。
Catering to students’ dietary needs, the cafeteria added gluten-free options. 为满足学生饮食需求，食堂增加了无麸质选项。

defs.cn: 天主教徒
天主教的, 普遍的, 广泛的, 宽宏大量的

words.root: kata-（全部）+ holos（整体）→ 普遍的
exs: His catholic interests include classical music, modern art, and foreign cinema. 他广泛的兴趣包括古典音乐、现代艺术和外国电影。
A catholic worldview, shaped by travel and study, helps people respect diverse cultures. 由旅行和学习塑造的广泛世界观帮助人们尊重多元文化。

defs.cn: 原因的, 因果关系的, 表示原因或理由的
表示原因的连词

words.root: caus-（原因）+ -al（形容词后缀）→ 因果的
exs: The report links causal factors to rising childhood obesity. 报告将因果因素与儿童肥胖问题上升联系起来。
Researchers found causal evidence that smoking increases lung cancer risk. 研究人员发现了吸烟增加肺癌风险的因果证据。

defs.cn: 洞, 空穴, 腔；[化] 空穴

words.root: cav-（洞）+ity→空穴
exs: The dentist found a small cavity in the child’s left molar. 牙医在孩子左侧磨牙上发现了一个小洞。
The skull contains cavities that protect delicate organs. 颅骨含有保护娇嫩器官的空腔。

defs.cn: 检查员
检查, 审查, 删改

words.root: cens-（评估）→ 审查、删改
exs: The government censor removed several controversial scenes from the film. 政府审查员删除了影片中几个有争议的场景。
Before publication, editors must censor any material that could violate privacy laws. 出版前，编辑必须审查任何可能侵犯隐私法的材料。

defs.cn: 集聚, 集中, 施行中央集权
集中

words.root: centr（中心）+ -ize（使）→ 使集中
exs: The government decided to centralize emergency medical resources. 政府决定集中调配紧急医疗资源。
Centralizing decision-making, the firm responded faster to customer complaints. 通过集中决策，该公司更快速地回应客户投诉。

defs.cn: 陶瓷的
陶瓷制品

words.root: keram（陶土）+ic→陶瓷的
exs: The museum displays a ceramic vase from the Tang Dynasty. 博物馆展出一件唐代陶瓷花瓶。
Ceramic tiles, which line the bathroom floor, resist water well. 铺在浴室地面的瓷砖很耐水。

defs.cn: 谷类食品, 谷类植物
谷类的

words.root: Ceres（谷物女神）→ 谷类
exs: A bowl of cereal provides quick energy before the morning lecture. 一碗谷物食品在上午讲座前提供快速能量。
Processed cereal often contains added sugar, which may harm children’s dental health. 加工谷物食品常含添加糖，可能损害儿童牙齿健康。

defs.cn: 木炭；[化] 木炭

words.root: char（烧焦）+ coal（煤）→ 木炭
exs: The artist used charcoal to sketch the old bridge. 艺术家用木炭为那座旧桥画素描。
Charcoal filters water because its pores trap tiny particles. 木炭能过滤水，因为其孔隙会截留细小颗粒。

defs.cn: 吸引力, 魔力, 符咒
迷住, 使陶醉, 行魔法
用符咒, 有魅力

words.root: carmen（歌/咒）→咒语→魅力
exs: The old town’s charm attracts many visitors each spring. 这座古镇的魅力每年春天吸引许多游客。
Charming the audience with his wit, the host opened the gala. 主持人以机智吸引观众，拉开了晚会序幕。

defs.cn: 陷窟, 裂口

words.root: 希腊 chasma（裂口）→ 深渊
exs: A dark chasm opened between the two cliffs after the earthquake. 地震后两处悬崖之间裂开一个黑暗深渊。
The widening chasm, caused by years of erosion, made the mountain path unsafe. 多年侵蚀造成的裂口扩大，使山路变得不安全。

defs.cn: 饶舌, 啁啾, 喋喋不休
喋喋不休地谈, (鸟)啭鸣

words.root: 拟声：牙齿/鸟快速“哒哒”响 → 喋喋不休
exs: The parrot's chatter filled the quiet kitchen every morning. 每天早晨，鹦鹉的喋喋不休都填满安静的厨房。
Chattering nervously, the students waited outside the interview room. 学生们紧张地喋喋不休，在面试室外等待。

defs.cn: 珍爱, 怀有, 爱护

words.root: cher（亲爱）→珍爱
exs: She cherishes the small garden beside her apartment. 她珍爱公寓旁的小花园。
Cherished by generations, the family recipe remains a treasured heirloom. 被几代人珍视的家传菜谱成为珍贵传家宝。

defs.cn: 栗子, 栗树, 栗色
栗色的

words.root: 拉丁 castanea（栗树）→ 栗子
exs: The old chestnut tree dropped glossy nuts onto the wet pavement. 老栗树把光亮的栗子掉在湿漉漉的人行道上。
Eating roasted chestnuts, the children warmed their hands in the winter market. 孩子们吃着烤栗子，在冬日集市上暖手。

defs.cn: 屑片, 薄片, 碎片
削, 切, 削成碎片, 使摔倒, 凿
削下屑片；[计] 孔屑; 组件; 晶片; 芯片

words.root: 画面：薯片薄脆“chip”→ 碎片/芯片
exs: A tiny chip fell from the antique wooden table. 一小片碎屑从古董木桌上掉落。
Engineers designed a chip that controls traffic lights efficiently. 工程师设计了一种能高效控制交通灯的芯片。

defs.cn: 弦, 和音；[医] 索, 带

words.root: 希腊语chordē（弦）→ 弦、和弦
exs: The guitarist played each string to form a clear chord. 吉他手拨动每根弦，形成一个清晰的和弦。
When the singer struck a minor chord, the audience fell silent. 当歌手弹出一个柔和的小调和弦时，观众安静下来。

defs.cn: 合唱队, 齐声
齐声说道, 合唱

words.root: cho像“唱”，orus像“众人”→ 众人齐唱
exs: The students sang the chorus together during the school concert. 学生们在学校音乐会上一起合唱副歌。
Hearing the chorus, the audience joined in singing the folk song. 听到合唱，观众跟着一起唱那首民歌。

defs.cn: 基督, 救世主

words.root: Christos（受膏者）→ 基督。
exs: Christ taught forgiveness through simple parables about lost sheep. 基督通过关于迷途羔羊的简单寓言教导宽恕。
Believing that Christ saves sinners, the pilgrim knelt before the wooden cross. 相信基督拯救罪人，朝圣者跪在木十字架前。

defs.cn: 慢性的, 习惯性的
慢性病患者

words.root: chron-（时间）+ -ic → 与时间有关 → 慢性的
exs: She suffers from chronic back pain after years of sitting. 多年久坐后，她患有慢性背痛。
Having chronic insomnia, he often reads quietly in bed. 患有慢性失眠，他常在床上安静读书。

defs.cn: 年代记, 记录, 编年史
把...载入编年史

words.root: chron（时间）→ 按时间记录
exs: The monk wrote a chronicle about local events. 那位僧人写了一部关于当地事件的编年史。
The historian chronicled events that shaped the early dynasty. 历史学家记载了塑造早期王朝的事件。

defs.cn: 雪茄

words.root: 画面：粗烟卷冒烟，像“西嘎”作响。
exs: The old man smoked a cigar on the porch every evening. 老人每晚在门廊上抽一支雪茄。
Rolling a cigar from dark tobacco leaves, the worker smelled an earthy sweetness. 工人卷着深色烟叶雪茄，闻到一股泥土般的甜香。

defs.cn: 纸烟, 卷烟, 香烟

words.root: 纸卷烟丝冒烟→香烟
exs: He lit a cigaret and stepped outside after dinner. 他晚饭后点燃一支香烟，走到外面。
Smoking a cigaret on the balcony, he watched the city lights fade. 他在阳台上抽着香烟，看着城市灯光渐渐暗下去。

defs.cn: 流通, 循环, 发行量；[化] 环流

words.root: circul（圆）+ ation → 循环/流通
exs: The magazine's circulation increased after the cover story. 封面报道后，该杂志的发行量上升了。
The nurse explained circulation, which keeps blood moving through the body. 护士讲解了血液循环，它使血液在体内流动。

defs.cn: 马戏团, 马戏, 竞技场

words.root: circ-（圆）→ 圆形场→马戏团。
exs: The circus tent glowed under colorful lights on the rainy night. 雨夜中马戏团帐篷在彩灯下发光。
Watching acrobats balance on ropes, the children gasped at the circus. 孩子们看着杂技演员在绳索上保持平衡，对马戏团惊叹。

defs.cn: 夹钳
夹紧, 强加

words.root: 钳子夹住木板→夹紧、强加
exs: The worker tightened the clamp on the broken pipe. 工人拧紧了破损管道上的夹钳。
To prevent leaks, she clamped the hose with a metal tool. 为防止漏水，她用金属工具夹紧了软管。

defs.cn: 冲突, 撞击声, 抵触
冲突, 抵触
使发出撞击声；[计] 对撞

words.root: cl像碰撞声，ash像惊叫→ 冲突/撞击
exs: The two teams clashed during the final match. 两队在决赛中发生冲突。
The clashing cymbals startled the audience at the concert. 音乐会上撞击的钹声惊动了观众。

defs.cn: 咔嗒声, 哗啦声, 嘈杂的谈笑声
发出哗啦声, 喧闹的谈笑
使咔嗒咔嗒地响

words.root: 拟声：咔啦咔啦→连续碰撞声。
exs: The clatter of plates came from the crowded kitchen. 盘子碰撞声从拥挤的厨房传来。
Horses clattered down the cobblestones while the carriage passed the old inn. 马车经过老客栈时，马蹄在鹅卵石上咔嗒作响。

defs.cn: 清洁, 干净

words.root: clean（干净）+ -ness → 清洁状态
exs: The restaurant earns praise for its spotless cleanliness. 这家餐厅因一尘不染的清洁而受到赞扬。
Keeping the kitchen clean, the cook values daily cleanliness. 保持厨房干净，厨师重视日常清洁。

defs.cn: 清扫, 空地, 票据清算；[经] 票据交换, 结算, 结帐

words.root: clear（清除）+ ing → 清扫/空地/清算
exs: The workers finished the clearing of fallen branches before dark. 工人在天黑前完成了清理倒下的树枝。
The bank, clearing checks overnight, reduced delays for customers. 银行连夜清算支票，减少了客户的延误。

defs.cn: 高潮, 极点, 层进法
(使)达到顶点, (使)达到高潮

words.root: klimax（梯子）→ 层层上升→高潮。
exs: The final chapter brings the novel to its emotional climax. 最后一章将小说推向情感高潮。
Climbing the ridge, the hikers reached the climax of their expedition. 登上山脊，徒步者到达了探险的高潮。

defs.cn: 粘紧, 附着, 紧贴, 坚持

words.root: cl像手抓+ing持续→粘紧、坚持
exs: The old label still clings to the bottle after hours in hot water. 旧标签泡在热水里几小时后仍粘在瓶子上。
Clinging to his dream of becoming a surgeon, he worked late into the night despite exhaustion. 他紧抱着成为外科医生的梦想，尽管疲惫仍工作到深夜。

defs.cn: 诊所, 临床教学；[医] 诊所(门诊部); 临床(讲解); 临床(学)科

words.root: clin（躺/斜靠）+ ic → 临床/诊所
exs: The small clinic opens early for elderly patients. 这家小诊所为老年患者提前开门。
Students visit the clinic, where doctors teach diagnosis. 学生参观诊所，在那里医生讲解诊断。

defs.cn: 临床的, 门诊部的；[医] 临床的, 临证的

words.root: clinic（诊所）+ -al→临床的。
exs: The clinical trial tested a new vaccine on volunteers. 临床试验在志愿者身上测试新疫苗。
Clinical observations showed that the patient recovered faster than expected. 临床观察显示患者恢复得比预期快。

defs.cn: 修剪, 夹子, 回形针, 剪下来的东西
修剪, 痛打, 夹牢, 剪报
剪报

words.root: 夹子“咔”一声，夹住剪报。
exs: The metal clip holds the newspaper clippings on the fridge. 金属夹子把剪报固定在冰箱上。
After clipping the article, he pinned it beside his study notes. 剪下文章后，他把剪报别在学习笔记旁。

defs.cn: 顺时针方向的
顺时针方向地

words.root: clock（钟）+wise（方向）→钟面指针方向
exs: The technician turned the valve clockwise to stop the leaking pipe. 技术员顺时针转动阀门以停止漏水管道。
Clockwise rotation, if applied gently, can loosen the stuck bolt without damaging the threads. 顺时针旋转若轻柔施加，可在不损坏螺纹的情况下松开卡住的螺栓。

defs.cn: 壁橱, 小室
秘密的, 空谈的
把...关入小室

words.root: close（关）+ -et（小）→ 关着门的小室。
exs: The child hid the broken vase inside the bedroom closet. 孩子把打碎的花瓶藏进卧室壁橱里。
The suspect was closeted in a small room before he gave his statement. 嫌疑犯在陈述前被关进一间小室。

defs.cn: 小丑, 乡下人

words.root: 红鼻子大鞋，滑稽“丑”角。
exs: The clown's exaggerated gestures delighted children in the crowded park. 在拥挤的公园里，小丑夸张的动作让孩子们很开心。
Juggling colorful balls, the clown made children laugh loudly. 抛接彩色球时，小丑让孩子们大笑起来。

defs.cn: 串, 丛, 群, 簇
成串, 丛生
使聚集；[计] 簇

words.root: 画面：葡萄成串，人群成团→cluster
exs: The researchers observed a dense cluster of stars near the galaxy's edge. 研究人员观察到星系边缘附近有一团密集的星群。
Data points that cluster around the mean suggest the survey results are fairly consistent. 聚集在均值附近的数据点表明调查结果相当一致。

defs.cn: 抓紧, 掌握, 离合器, 一窝小鸡
抓住, 踩汽车离合器踏板
抓；[计] 联轴器; 离合器

words.root: 像离合器一样一踩就抓住动力→抓紧。
exs: He clutched his ticket tightly in the crowded station. 他在拥挤的车站紧紧攥着车票。
The frightened child, clutching his mother's hand, crossed the busy street. 那个受惊的孩子攥着妈妈的手穿过繁忙的街道。

defs.cn: 结合体, 结合, 联合；[经] 联合, 联盟

words.root: co-（共同）+结合→联盟。
exs: The fragile coalition collapsed after the controversial tax reform. 脆弱的联盟在争议性税改后瓦解。
Although they had different views, the parties formed a coalition. 尽管观点不同，各政党还是组成了联盟。

defs.cn: 海岸的, 沿海的, 沿岸的；[法] 海岸的, 沿海的

words.root: coast海岸+al形容词后缀→沿海的
exs: Coastal villages often depend on fishing and tourism for their income. 沿海村庄通常依靠渔业和旅游业获得收入。
Rising sea levels threaten coastal cities, forcing residents to consider relocation plans. 海平面上升威胁沿海城市，迫使居民考虑搬迁计划。

defs.cn: 系数；[计] 系数

words.root: co-(共同)+efficient(有效)→共同作用数值。
exs: The teacher explained the coefficient of friction with a simple experiment. 老师用一个简单实验解释了摩擦系数。
Students often struggle with coefficients that appear in physics equations. 学生常对物理公式中出现的系数感到困惑。

defs.cn: 棺材, 灵柩
把...装进棺材

words.root: 希腊语“篮子”→像篮子→棺材。
exs: The polished coffin rested quietly in the old church hall. 光亮的棺材静静放在老教堂大厅里。
Carrying the heavy coffin, the mourners walked slowly toward the grave. 抬着沉重棺材，哀悼者缓缓走向墓穴。

defs.cn: 认知的, 认识的

words.root: cogn（知道）+itive→认知的
exs: Sleep deprivation can impair cognitive performance during complex academic tasks. 睡眠不足会损害复杂学术任务中的认知表现。
Children develop cognitive skills through play, which helps them understand social rules. 儿童通过游戏发展认知技能，这有助于他们理解社会规则。

defs.cn: 互相耦合的, 清晰的, 明了的，凝聚性的, 连贯的

words.root: co-(共同)+her(粘)→粘在一起→连贯。
exs: The report gives a coherent account of the company's decline. 报告对公司衰落的过程作了连贯说明。
The speaker organized his ideas so that the argument became coherent. 演讲者整理思路，使论点变得连贯。

defs.cn: 一致, 符合；[化] 重合

words.root: co-（共同）+incid（落下）→巧合。
exs: The survey results coincide with previous findings about urban migration. 调查结果与之前关于城市迁移的发现一致。
When the data are plotted, the trends coincide almost perfectly. 当数据被绘制出来时，趋势几乎完全重合。

defs.cn: 巧合, 同时发生；[电] 符合计数器

words.root: co-（共同）+cid（落下）→同时发生→巧合
exs: Meeting my old professor in Paris was a surprising coincidence. 在巴黎遇见我的老教授是一个令人惊讶的巧合。
The two discoveries were not a coincidence, as both studies examined the same enzyme. 这两项发现并非巧合，因为两项研究都考察了同一种酶。

defs.cn: 合作, 勾结；[法] 通敌卖国者, 奸细

words.root: col-(共同)+labor(劳动)+-ation→合作。
exs: The two artists began a collaboration on a public mural. 两位艺术家开始合作创作一幅公共壁画。
The professor warned that collaboration without trust often produces poor results. 教授提醒，没有信任的合作往往产生糟糕结果。

defs.cn: 碰撞, 互撞, 抵触

words.root: col-（共同）+撞→互撞。
exs: Two cars collide at the intersection during heavy rain. 暴雨中两辆车在路口相撞。
The two opinions collide whenever the committee discusses budget cuts. 每当委员会讨论削减预算时，两种意见就冲突。

defs.cn: 殖民的, 殖民地的；[法] 殖民地居民

words.root: colony殖民地+al→殖民的
exs: The museum displays artifacts from the colonial period of the country. 博物馆展出该国殖民时期的文物。
Colonial architecture, built with imported materials, reflects the power of imperial rule. 采用进口材料建造的殖民建筑反映了帝国统治的权力。

defs.cn: 殖民地居民, 移民

words.root: colony(殖民地)+-ist(人)→殖民者。
exs: The colonist built a wooden house near the river. 殖民地居民在河边建了一座木屋。
Many colonists who arrived in the 17th century faced severe winters. 许多十七世纪抵达的殖民者遭遇了严冬。

defs.cn: 燃烧, 骚动；[化] 燃烧

words.root: com-（一起）+ urere（烧）→燃烧
exs: Internal combustion engines power most cars, trucks, and buses worldwide. 内燃机为世界上大多数汽车、卡车和公共汽车提供动力。
When oxygen combines with fuel, rapid combustion releases heat and light. 当氧气与燃料结合时，剧烈燃烧会释放热量和光。

defs.cn: (使)开始, 得学位

words.root: com-（共同）+ mence（像“门”）→ 开门开始
exs: The ceremony will commence promptly at nine in the main auditorium. 典礼将于九点在主礼堂准时开始。
Having completed the registration, students commenced their final presentations in the lecture hall. 完成注册后，学生们在讲堂开始了期末展示。

defs.cn: 嘉奖, 委托给, 推荐

words.root: com-（共同）+ mand（委托）→ 托付→嘉奖
exs: The university commended the student for leading a rural literacy project. 大学嘉奖该学生领导乡村扫盲项目。
Commended by the mayor, the nurse proposed a practical vaccination plan. 市长嘉奖后，护士提出了一个务实的疫苗接种计划。

defs.cn: 注释, 评论, 说明；[法] 注释, 评注, 评论

words.root: comment（评论）+ -ary（名词）→评论文字
exs: The professor's commentary clarified several ambiguous passages in the ancient manuscript. 教授的注释澄清了古代手稿中几处模糊的段落。
While watching the documentary, listeners heard a lively commentary explaining complex historical events. 观看纪录片时，听众听到一段生动的解说，解释了复杂的历史事件。

defs.cn: 寻常事, 老生常谈, 普通的东西
平凡的, 普通的

words.root: common（普通）+ place（地方）→ 常见 → 平凡
exs: For many urban commuters, crowded trains are a commonplace part of daily life. 对许多城市通勤者来说，拥挤的火车是日常生活的寻常部分。
Although the smartphone seems commonplace today, it transformed how people communicate. 尽管智能手机今天看似寻常，它改变了人们沟通的方式。

defs.cn: 有常识的, 一望而知的, 明明白白的

words.root: common（普通）+ sense（感觉）→ 常识
exs: A commonsense budget prevented the company from a severe cash shortage. 一项合乎常识的预算使公司避免了严重的现金短缺。
Seeing the misleading statistics, the analyst made a commonsense correction. 看到误导性的统计数据，分析师做出了一个合乎常识的修正。

defs.cn: 共和国；联邦；国民整体

words.root: common（共同）+ wealth（财富）→联邦
exs: The commonwealth passed new legislation for small businesses after the recession. 该联邦在衰退后通过了针对小企业的新立法。
The commonwealth, which includes several former colonies, promotes trade and cultural exchange among its members. 这个包括若干前殖民地的联邦促进成员国之间的贸易和文化交流。

defs.cn: 交换, 折偿, 减轻
代偿, 经常乘车来往

words.root: com-（共同）+ mut（改变）→ 交换/减刑/往返
exs: She commutes by subway between her suburban home and the downtown office. 她乘地铁往返于郊区住所和市中心办公室。
The judge commuted the sentence after the defendant showed genuine remorse. 被告表现出真诚悔意后，法官减轻了刑罚。

defs.cn: 紧凑的, 紧密的, 简洁的
使紧密结合, 压缩
变坚实

words.root: com-（共同）+ pact（压紧）→ 紧凑
exs: The compact textbook includes useful examples for college entrance exams. 这本紧凑的教材包含对高考有用的例子。
Compacted into a brief summary, the research findings impressed the panel. 压缩成简短摘要后，研究结果给评审团留下深刻印象。

defs.cn: 兼容性；[计] 兼容性

words.root: com-（共同）+ pati（忍受）→兼容性
exs: Software compatibility issues often frustrate users during major operating system updates. 在重大操作系统更新期间，软件兼容性问题常令用户沮丧。
Before launching the product, engineers tested its compatibility with various devices. 在产品发布前，工程师测试了它与各种设备的兼容性。

defs.cn: 能共处的, 可并立的, 适合的；[计] 相容的; 兼容的

words.root: com-（共同）+ pati（忍受）→ 能共处
exs: The new software is compatible with most older computers in the lab. 新软件与实验室里大多数旧电脑兼容。
Although their schedules differ, they are compatible enough to coauthor a paper. 尽管日程不同，他们仍能合作写论文。

defs.cn: 同国人
同国的, 同胞的

words.root: com-（共同）+ patri（祖国）→ 同胞
exs: A compatriot offered the exchange student temporary housing near campus. 一位同胞为交换生提供了校园附近的临时住所。
The journalist interviewed a compatriot who had rescued flood victims abroad. 记者采访了一位曾在国外营救洪灾受害者的同胞。

defs.cn: 偿还, 补偿, 付报酬

words.root: com-（加强）+ pens（支付）→补偿
exs: The company will compensate customers for late deliveries. 公司将就延迟交货向客户作出补偿。
If the product fails inspection, the manufacturer must compensate the buyer for the loss. 如果产品未通过检验，制造商必须赔偿买方的损失。

defs.cn: 补偿, 赔偿金, 工资；[医] 代偿(机能), 补偿

words.root: com-（共同）+ pens（权衡/付出）→ 补偿
exs: The company offered financial compensation to residents affected by the pipeline leak. 公司向受管道泄漏影响的居民提供了经济补偿。
After the accident, workers received compensation because the factory admitted negligence. 事故后，由于工厂承认疏忽，工人获得了赔偿。

defs.cn: 胜任, 职称, 能力；[医] 能力, 活性

words.root: com-（共同）+ pet（追求）→ 够格能力
exs: Her competence in statistical modeling secured a prestigious internship. 她在统计建模方面的能力让她获得了一个知名实习机会。
Demonstrating professional competence, the intern redesigned the customer survey. 实习生展现出专业能力，重新设计了客户调查。

defs.cn: 竞争者；[经] 竞争者, 竞争对手

words.root: com-（一起）+ pet（追求）→竞争者
exs: Each competitor lowered prices in the smartphone market last quarter. 上季度每个竞争对手都降低了智能手机市场的价格。
The company hired a consultant to analyze how each competitor prices its products. 公司聘请顾问分析每个竞争对手如何为其产品定价。

defs.cn: 补足物, 补语, 补数
补充, 补足；[计] 补码; 反相器; 补数

words.root: com-（共同）+ ple（填满）→ 补足
exs: A short summary can complement the lengthy report without repeating its details. 简短摘要可以补充冗长报告，而不重复细节。
The museum's interactive exhibits complement the ancient artifacts, helping visitors understand daily life. 博物馆的互动展品补充了古代文物，帮助参观者理解日常生活。

defs.cn: 完成；[经] 完井, 结束, 完工

words.root: com-（共同）+ plet（填满）→ 完成
exs: The completion of the research report strengthened the grant application. 研究报告的完成增强了资助申请。
Having reached completion, the bridge project reduced commute time sharply. 桥梁项目完工后，通勤时间大幅减少。

defs.cn: 复杂, 复杂性, 复杂的事物

words.root: com-（一起）+ plex（编织）→ 复杂性
exs: Urban traffic congestion adds complexity to emergency medical response. 城市交通拥堵增加了紧急医疗响应的复杂性。
The committee postponed the project because the algorithm's complexity exceeded available computing power. 委员会推迟了该项目，因为算法复杂性超出了可用算力。

defs.cn: 复杂化, 复杂情况；[医] 并发症, 并发病

words.root: com-+plic(折)→缠绕→并发症
exs: The patient developed a serious complication after the surgery. 患者术后出现了严重并发症。
Ignoring early symptoms often leads to complications that require intensive medical treatment. 忽视早期症状常会导致需要强化医疗的并发症。

defs.cn: 称赞, 恭维, 敬意
称赞, 褒扬, 恭维

words.root: com-（共同）+ple（填满）→说满好话→恭维
exs: The teacher complimented her clear pronunciation during the oral exam. 老师在口试中称赞她发音清晰。
Receiving many compliments, the student practiced more confidently before the final exam. 收到许多称赞后，这名学生在期末考前更自信地练习。

defs.cn: 顺从, 依从；[法] 遵守, 承诺, 照做

words.root: 一起(com)+弯折(ply)→顺从
exs: All employees must comply with the new data retention policy. 所有员工必须遵守新的数据保留政策。
Failing to comply with safety regulations, the factory was fined heavily. 由于未能遵守安全法规，该工厂被重罚。

defs.cn: 作曲家, 作家, 调停者

words.root: com-+pos(放)+-er→组合音符→作曲家
exs: The composer wrote a symphony for the city orchestra. 这位作曲家为城市管弦乐团写了一部交响曲。
The composer, who had studied folk music, created a memorable opera. 这位研究过民间音乐的作曲家创作了一部令人难忘的歌剧。

defs.cn: 合成的, 混合成的, 菊科的
合成物, 复合材料, 菊科

words.root: com-+pos（放）→放在一起→合成的
exs: This composite material resists heat and pressure in aircraft parts. 这种复合材料在飞机部件中耐热耐压。
The engineer explained that the composite panel was lighter than steel. 工程师解释说，这种复合板比钢更轻。

defs.cn: 理解, 包括

words.root: com-（一起）+ prehens（抓）→ 理解
exs: The statute comprehends every form of digital harassment. 该法规涵盖各种形式的网络骚扰。
Comprehending the data's limits, the analyst avoided bold conclusions. 认识到数据的局限后，分析员避免了大胆结论。

defs.cn: 压缩, 压紧；[计] 压缩

words.root: com-+press(压)→压在一起→压缩
exs: Data compression saves disk space and speeds up file transfer. 数据压缩节省磁盘空间并加快文件传输。
By using lossy compression, engineers reduced the size of the audio file. 通过有损压缩，工程师减小了音频文件的大小。

defs.cn: 被强制的, 强迫的, 义务的；[经] 强迫的, 强制的

words.root: com-+puls（推）→被推着做→义务的
exs: The school made swimming a compulsory subject for all freshmen. 学校将游泳设为所有新生的必修课。
Students who refuse compulsory community service may lose their scholarship. 拒绝参加强制社区服务的学生可能失去奖学金。

defs.cn: 承认, 退让
让步

words.root: con-（一起）+ cede（走）→ 退让
exs: The government conceded defeat after months of public criticism. 政府在数月公众批评后承认失败。
Conceding defeat, the candidate gave a gracious speech to supporters. 承认失败后，候选人向支持者发表了优雅演讲。

defs.cn: 自负, 空想, 狂妄

words.root: 与concept同源，想法过头→自负
exs: His conceit made him reject useful criticism from colleagues. 他的自负使他拒绝同事的有用批评。
The manager's conceit was so strong that he ignored all warnings. 经理的自负很强，以至于他忽视所有警告。

defs.cn: 集中的, 浓缩的；[建] 浓的

words.root: con-+centr（中心）→聚拢→浓缩
exs: The concentrated juice tasted too sweet for most children. 这种浓缩果汁对多数孩子来说太甜了。
Having concentrated his attention, the student solved the final problem. 集中注意力后，这名学生解出了最后一道题。

defs.cn: 特许, 让步, 认可；[经] 核准, 许可, 特殊(权)

words.root: concede（让步）+ -ion → 让步
exs: The union secured a major concession on weekend working hours. 工会在周末工作时长上争取到重大让步。
After long negotiations, the company offered a concession to keep the contract. 经过长时间谈判，公司作出让步以保住合同。

defs.cn: 简洁的, 简明的

words.root: con-+cis(切)→切到一起→简洁
exs: Her concise summary impressed all the senior managers. 她简洁的总结给所有高级经理留下深刻印象。
To be concise, I will omit the technical details in this report. 为了简洁，我将在报告中省略技术细节。

defs.cn: 授予, 带来
协商

words.root: con-+fer（带）→带到一起→授予/协商
exs: The university conferred an honorary degree on the retired scientist. 大学授予这位退休科学家荣誉学位。
Before conferring with experts, the minister announced a temporary ban. 在与专家协商之前，部长宣布了临时禁令。

defs.cn: 机密的, 获他人信赖的, 易于信任他人的；[经] 秘密件

words.root: con-（一起）+ fid（信任）→ 机密
exs: Please keep the patient's medical records strictly confidential. 请严格保密患者的病历。
The lawyer refused to disclose information that was confidential. 律师拒绝披露机密信息。

defs.cn: 结构, 表面配置, 外形, 配置；[计] 配置

words.root: con-+figur(形)→共同成形→配置
exs: The system's configuration includes a firewall and two databases. 系统配置包括一个防火墙和两个数据库。
Before updating the software, check the configuration to avoid compatibility errors. 更新软件前检查配置，以避免兼容性错误。

defs.cn: 证实, 证明, 批准, 确认；[计] 确认

words.root: con-+firm（坚固）→使坚定→确认
exs: The email gave immediate confirmation of her interview appointment. 这封邮件立即确认了她的面试安排。
After receiving confirmation, the applicant booked a flight to campus. 收到确认后，申请人预订了前往校园的航班。

defs.cn: 使一致, 使遵守, 使符合
一致, 符合, 适应
